1→"""Orchestrator module — parallel sub-task coordination.
     2→
     3→Decides when a task benefits from parallel work and coordinates results.
     4→Today: function calls in threads with filtered tool access.
     5→Tomorrow: Agent SDK sub-agents with isolated context windows.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→import concurrent.futures
     9→import logging
    10→import threading
    11→import time
    12→import uuid
    13→
    14→from ..tools._util import to_json
    15→
    16→log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    17→
    18→# Max concurrent sub-tasks (matches global constraint)
    19→_MAX_CONCURRENT = 3
    20→_SUBTASK_TIMEOUT_S = 60
    21→_COMPLETED_TTL_S = 600  # Evict completed tasks after 10 minutes
    22→
    23→# Active sub-tasks: {task_id: {"status": ..., "result": ..., ...}}
    24→_active_tasks: dict[str, dict] = {}
    25→_tasks_lock = threading.Lock()
    26→
    27→# Tool access levels for sub-tasks
    28→_TOOL_PROFILES = {
    29→    "researcher": {
    30→        "description": "Read-only research: inspect, discover, search",
    31→        "allowed_tools": {
    32→            "is_comfyui_running", "get_all_nodes", "get_node_info",
    33→            "get_system_stats", "get_queue_status",
    34→            "list_custom_nodes", "list_models", "get_models_summary", "read_node_source",
    35→            "search_custom_nodes", "search_models", "find_missing_nodes",
    36→            "load_workflow", "validate_workflow", "get_editable_fields",
    37→            "list_workflow_templates",
    38→            "get_learned_patterns", "get_recommendations",
    39→        },
    40→    },
    41→    "builder": {
    42→        "description": "Full PILOT access: can modify workflows",
    43→        "allowed_tools": {
    44→            "apply_workflow_patch", "preview_workflow_patch", "undo_workflow_patch",
    45→            "get_workflow_diff", "save_workflow", "reset_workflow",
    46→            "add_node", "connect_nodes", "set_input",
    47→            "get_workflow_template",
    48→            "validate_before_execute",
    49→        },
    50→    },
    51→    "validator": {
    52→        "description": "Validation and execution",
    53→        "allowed_tools": {
    54→            "validate_before_execute", "execute_workflow", "get_execution_status",
    55→            "analyze_image", "compare_outputs",
    56→        },
    57→    },
    58→}
    59→
    60→
    61→TOOLS: list[dict] = [
    62→    {
    63→        "name": "spawn_subtask",
    64→        "description": (
    65→            "Launch a focused sub-task in a background thread with filtered "
    66→            "tool access. Use when the planner identifies independent work "
    67→            "that can run in parallel (e.g., research multiple options simultaneously). "
    68→            "Max 3 concurrent sub-tasks."
    69→        ),
    70→        "input_schema": {
    71→            "type": "object",
    72→            "properties": {
    73→                "task_description": {
    74→                    "type": "string",
    75→                    "description": "What this sub-task should accomplish.",
    76→                },
    77→                "profile": {
    78→                    "type": "string",
    79→                    "enum": ["researcher", "builder", "validator"],
    80→                    "description": (
    81→                        "Tool access profile. 'researcher' = read-only, "
    82→                        "'builder' = can modify workflows, "
    83→                        "'validator' = can execute and analyze."
    84→                    ),
    85→                },
    86→                "tool_calls": {
    87→                    "type": "array",
    88→                    "items": {
    89→                        "type": "object",
    90→                        "properties": {
    91→                            "tool": {"type": "string"},
    92→                            "input": {"type": "object"},
    93→                        },
    94→                        "required": ["tool", "input"],
    95→                    },
    96→                    "description": "List of tool calls to execute in sequence.",
    97→                },
    98→            },
    99→            "required": ["task_description", "profile", "tool_calls"],
   100→        },
   101→    },
   102→    {
   103→        "name": "check_subtasks",
   104→        "description": (
   105→            "Check the status of all active sub-tasks. Returns completed "
   106→            "results and progress updates for running tasks."
   107→        ),
   108→        "input_schema": {
   109→            "type": "object",
   110→            "properties": {
   111→                "task_ids": {
   112→                    "type": "array",
   113→                    "items": {"type": "string"},
   114→                    "description": "Specific task IDs to check. If empty, checks all active tasks.",
   115→                },
   116→            },
   117→            "required": [],
   118→        },
   119→    },
   120→]
   121→
   122→
   123→def _evict_stale_tasks() -> None:
   124→    """Remove completed/errored tasks older than TTL. Must be called with _tasks_lock held."""
   125→    now = time.time()
   126→    stale = [
   127→        tid for tid, task in _active_tasks.items()
   128→        if task["status"] in ("completed", "error", "timeout")
   129→        and now - task.get("completed_at", task.get("started_at", now)) > _COMPLETED_TTL_S
   130→    ]
   131→    for tid in stale:
   132→        del _active_tasks[tid]
   133→
   134→
   135→def _run_subtask(task_id: str, profile: str, tool_calls: list[dict]) -> dict:
   136→    """Execute a sequence of tool calls with filtered access."""
   137→    from ..tools import handle as handle_tool
   138→
   139→    allowed = _TOOL_PROFILES.get(profile, {}).get("allowed_tools", set())
   140→    results = []
   141→
   142→    for call in tool_calls:
   143→        tool_name = call["tool"]
   144→        tool_input = call.get("input", {})
   145→
   146→        if tool_name not in allowed:
   147→            results.append({
   148→                "tool": tool_name,
   149→                "error": f"Tool '{tool_name}' not allowed in '{profile}' profile.",
   150→            })
   151→            continue
   152→
   153→        try:
   154→            t0 = time.monotonic()
   155→            result = handle_tool(tool_name, tool_input)
   156→            elapsed = time.monotonic() - t0
   157→            results.append({
   158→                "tool": tool_name,
   159→                "result": result,
   160→                "elapsed_s": round(elapsed, 2),
   161→            })
   162→        except Exception as e:
   163→            results.append({
   164→                "tool": tool_name,
   165→                "error": str(e),
   166→            })
   167→
   168→    return {
   169→        "task_id": task_id,
   170→        "status": "completed",
   171→        "results": results,
   172→        "completed_at": time.time(),
   173→    }
   174→
   175→
   176→def _handle_spawn_subtask(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   177→    task_description = tool_input["task_description"]
   178→    profile = tool_input["profile"]
   179→    tool_calls = tool_input["tool_calls"]
   180→
   181→    with _tasks_lock:
   182→        _evict_stale_tasks()
   183→        # Check concurrency limit
   184→        active_count = sum(
   185→            1 for t in _active_tasks.values() if t["status"] == "running"
   186→        )
   187→    if active_count >= _MAX_CONCURRENT:
   188→        return to_json({
   189→            "error": f"Max {_MAX_CONCURRENT} concurrent sub-tasks. Wait for one to finish.",
   190→            "active_count": active_count,
   191→        })
   192→
   193→    # Validate profile
   194→    if profile not in _TOOL_PROFILES:
   195→        return to_json({
   196→            "error": f"Unknown profile: {profile}",
   197→            "available": list(_TOOL_PROFILES.keys()),
   198→        })
   199→
   200→    # Validate tool access
   201→    allowed = _TOOL_PROFILES[profile]["allowed_tools"]
   202→    for call in tool_calls:
   203→        if call["tool"] not in allowed:
   204→            return to_json({
   205→                "error": f"Tool '{call['tool']}' not allowed in '{profile}' profile.",
   206→                "allowed_tools": sorted(allowed),
   207→            })
   208→
   209→    task_id = uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
   210→
   211→    with _tasks_lock:
   212→        _active_tasks[task_id] = {
   213→            "status": "running",
   214→            "description": task_description,
   215→            "profile": profile,
   216→            "started_at": time.time(),
   217→            "tool_count": len(tool_calls),
   218→        }
   219→
   220→    # Run in background thread
   221→    executor = concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1)
   222→    future = executor.submit(_run_subtask, task_id, profile, tool_calls)
   223→
   224→    def _on_done(fut):
   225→        try:
   226→            result = fut.result(timeout=_SUBTASK_TIMEOUT_S)
   227→            with _tasks_lock:
   228→                _active_tasks[task_id].update(result)
   229→        except concurrent.futures.TimeoutError:
   230→            with _tasks_lock:
   231→                _active_tasks[task_id]["status"] = "timeout"
   232→                _active_tasks[task_id]["error"] = f"Timed out after {_SUBTASK_TIMEOUT_S}s"
   233→        except Exception as e:
   234→            with _tasks_lock:
   235→                _active_tasks[task_id]["status"] = "error"
   236→                _active_tasks[task_id]["error"] = str(e)
   237→        finally:
   238→            executor.shutdown(wait=False)
   239→
   240→    future.add_done_callback(_on_done)
   241→
   242→    return to_json({
   243→        "spawned": True,
   244→        "task_id": task_id,
   245→        "description": task_description,
   246→        "profile": profile,
   247→        "tool_count": len(tool_calls),
   248→        "message": f"Sub-task '{task_id}' spawned with {len(tool_calls)} tool calls ({profile} profile).",
   249→    })
   250→
   251→
   252→def _handle_check_subtasks(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   253→    task_ids = tool_input.get("task_ids", [])
   254→
   255→    with _tasks_lock:
   256→        _evict_stale_tasks()
   257→        if task_ids:
   258→            tasks = {tid: _active_tasks[tid] for tid in task_ids if tid in _active_tasks}
   259→        else:
   260→            tasks = dict(_active_tasks)
   261→
   262→    if not tasks:
   263→        return to_json({"tasks": [], "message": "No active sub-tasks."})
   264→
   265→    summaries = []
   266→    for tid, task in sorted(tasks.items()):
   267→        summary = {
   268→            "task_id": tid,
   269→            "status": task["status"],
   270→            "description": task.get("description", ""),
   271→            "profile": task.get("profile", ""),
   272→        }
   273→
   274→        if task["status"] == "completed":
   275→            results = task.get("results", [])
   276→            summary["tool_results"] = len(results)
   277→            summary["errors"] = sum(1 for r in results if "error" in r)
   278→            summary["results"] = results
   279→        elif task["status"] == "running":
   280→            elapsed = time.time() - task.get("started_at", time.time())
   281→            summary["elapsed_s"] = round(elapsed, 1)
   282→            summary["tool_count"] = task.get("tool_count", 0)
   283→        elif task["status"] in ("error", "timeout"):
   284→            summary["error"] = task.get("error", "Unknown error")
   285→
   286→        summaries.append(summary)
   287→
   288→    completed = sum(1 for s in summaries if s["status"] == "completed")
   289→    running = sum(1 for s in summaries if s["status"] == "running")
   290→
   291→    return to_json({
   292→        "tasks": summaries,
   293→        "summary": {
   294→            "total": len(summaries),
   295→            "completed": completed,
   296→            "running": running,
   297→            "errors": sum(1 for s in summaries if s["status"] in ("error", "timeout")),
   298→        },
   299→    })
   300→
   301→
   302→def handle(name: str, tool_input: dict) -> str:
   303→    """Execute an orchestrator tool call."""
   304→    if name == "spawn_subtask":
   305→        return _handle_spawn_subtask(tool_input)
   306→    elif name == "check_subtasks":
   307→        return _handle_check_subtasks(tool_input)
   308→    else:
   309→        return to_json({"error": f"Unknown orchestrator tool: {name}"})
   310→

   394→def _compute_average_hash(img, hash_size: int = 8) -> int:
   395→    """Compute average hash (aHash) — resize to hash_size, compare to mean."""
   396→    resized = img.convert("L").resize((hash_size, hash_size), Image.LANCZOS)
   397→    pixels = list(resized.getdata())
   398→    mean = sum(pixels) / len(pixels)  # Integer pixels — sum is exact, order-invariant
   399→    bits = 0
   400→    for i, p in enumerate(pixels):
   401→        if p > mean:
   402→            bits |= 1 << i
   403→    return bits
   404→
   405→
   406→def _hamming_distance(h1: int, h2: int) -> int:
   407→    """Count differing bits between two hashes."""
   408→    x = h1 ^ h2
   409→    count = 0
   410→    while x:
   411→        count += 1
   412→        x &= x - 1
   413→    return count
   414→
   415→
   416→def _pixel_diff(img_a, img_b) -> dict:
   417→    """Compare pixels between two images. Returns diff stats."""
   418→    # Resize both to same dimensions for comparison
   419→    size = (min(img_a.width, img_b.width), min(img_a.height, img_b.height))
   420→    a = img_a.resize(size).convert("RGB")
   421→    b = img_b.resize(size).convert("RGB")
   422→
   423→    pixels_a = list(a.getdata())
   424→    pixels_b = list(b.getdata())
   425→    total = len(pixels_a)
   426→
   427→    if total == 0:
   428→        return {"diff_pixels": 0, "diff_pct": 0.0, "avg_color_delta": 0.0}
   429→
   430→    diff_count = 0
   431→    total_delta = 0.0
   432→    threshold = 10  # Per-channel difference threshold to count as "different"
   433→
   434→    for pa, pb in zip(pixels_a, pixels_b):
   435→        channel_diff = sum(abs(ca - cb) for ca, cb in zip(pa, pb))
   436→        avg_diff = channel_diff / 3
   437→        if avg_diff > threshold:
   438→            diff_count += 1
   439→        total_delta += avg_diff
   440→
   441→    return {
   442→        "diff_pixels": diff_count,
   443→        "diff_pct": round(diff_count / total * 100, 2),
   444→        "avg_color_delta": round(total_delta / total, 2),
   445→    }
   446→
   447→
   448→def _handle_hash_compare(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   449→    image_a = tool_input["image_a"]
   450→    image_b = tool_input["image_b"]
   451→
   452→    if not _HAS_PIL:
   453→        return to_json({
   454→            "error": "Pillow not installed. Install with: pip install Pillow",
   455→            "fallback": "Use compare_outputs for Vision API comparison.",
   456→        })
   457→
   458→    path_a = Path(image_a)
   459→    path_b = Path(image_b)
   460→
   461→    if not path_a.exists():
   462→        return to_json({"error": f"Image not found: {image_a}"})
   463→    if not path_b.exists():
   464→        return to_json({"error": f"Image not found: {image_b}"})
   465→
   466→    try:
   467→        img_a = Image.open(path_a)
   468→        img_b = Image.open(path_b)
   469→    except Exception as e:
   470→        return to_json({"error": f"Failed to open images: {e}"})
   471→
   472→    # Compute average hash
   473→    hash_a = _compute_average_hash(img_a)
   474→    hash_b = _compute_average_hash(img_b)
   475→    hamming = _hamming_distance(hash_a, hash_b)
   476→    hash_similarity = round(1.0 - hamming / 64, 4)  # 64 bits for 8x8 hash
   477→
   478→    # Pixel-level diff
   479→    diff = _pixel_diff(img_a, img_b)
   480→
   481→    # Classification
   482→    if hamming == 0 and diff["diff_pct"] == 0:
   483→        verdict = "identical"
   484→    elif hamming <= 2 and diff["diff_pct"] < 1.0:
   485→        verdict = "near_identical"
   486→    elif hamming <= 8 and diff["diff_pct"] < 10.0:
   487→        verdict = "similar"
   488→    elif hamming <= 16:
   489→        verdict = "different"
   490→    else:
   491→        verdict = "very_different"
   492→
   493→    return to_json({
   494→        "verdict": verdict,
   495→        "hash_similarity": hash_similarity,
   496→        "hamming_distance": hamming,
   497→        "pixel_diff_pct": diff["diff_pct"],
   498→        "avg_color_delta": diff["avg_color_delta"],
   499→        "diff_pixels": diff["diff_pixels"],
   500→        "resolution_a": f"{img_a.width}x{img_a.height}",
   501→        "resolution_b": f"{img_b.width}x{img_b.height}",
   502→        "image_a": image_a,
   503→        "image_b": image_b,
   504→    })
   505→
   506→
   507→def handle(name: str, tool_input: dict) -> str:
   508→    """Execute a vision tool call."""
   509→    if name == "analyze_image":
   510→        return _handle_analyze_image(tool_input)
   511→    elif name == "compare_outputs":
   512→        return _handle_compare_outputs(tool_input)
   513→    elif name == "hash_compare_images":
   514→        return _handle_hash_compare(tool_input)
   515→    elif name == "suggest_improvements":
   516→        return _handle_suggest_improvements(tool_input)
   517→    else:
   518→        return to_json({"error": f"Unknown vision tool: {name}"})

1→"""Brain layer for the ComfyUI SUPER DUPER Agent.
     2→
     3→Adds higher-order capabilities on top of the intelligence layers:
     4→  Vision    — see and critique generated images
     5→  Planner   — decompose goals into tracked sub-tasks
     6→  Memory    — learn from outcomes, recommend what works
     7→  Orchestrator — coordinate parallel sub-tasks
     8→  Optimizer — GPU-aware performance engineering
     9→  Demo      — guided walkthroughs for streams/podcasts
    10→
    11→Each module exports:
    12→  TOOLS: list[dict]    -- Anthropic tool schemas
    13→  handle(name, input)  -- Execute a tool call, return result string
    14→"""
    15→
    16→import logging
    17→
    18→from . import vision, planner, memory, orchestrator, optimizer, demo
    19→
    20→log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    21→
    22→_MODULES = (vision, planner, memory, orchestrator, optimizer, demo)
    23→
    24→# Collect all brain tool schemas
    25→ALL_BRAIN_TOOLS: list[dict] = []
    26→for _mod in _MODULES:
    27→    ALL_BRAIN_TOOLS.extend(_mod.TOOLS)
    28→
    29→# Map tool name -> handler module
    30→_HANDLERS = {}
    31→for _mod in _MODULES:
    32→    for _tool in _mod.TOOLS:
    33→        _HANDLERS[_tool["name"]] = _mod
    34→
    35→
    36→def handle(name: str, tool_input: dict) -> str:
    37→    """Dispatch a brain tool call to the right handler."""
    38→    mod = _HANDLERS.get(name)
    39→    if mod is None:
    40→        log.warning("Unknown brain tool called: %s", name)
    41→        return f"Unknown brain tool: {name}"
    42→    try:
    43→        return mod.handle(name, tool_input)
    44→    except Exception as e:
    45→        log.error("Unhandled error in brain tool %s", name, exc_info=True)
    46→        from ..tools._util import to_json
    47→        return to_json({"error": f"Internal error in {name}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}"})

1→"""Shared utilities for tool modules.
     2→
     3→He2025 alignment: deterministic JSON serialization ensures
     4→same inputs -> same outputs across sessions and runs.
     5→"""
     6→
     7→import json as _json
     8→from pathlib import Path
     9→
    10→# Directories that tools are allowed to read/write within.
    11→# Populated lazily from config to avoid circular imports.
    12→_SAFE_DIRS: list[Path] | None = None
    13→
    14→_BLOCKED_PREFIXES = (
    15→    "C:\\Windows", "C:\\Program Files", "C:\\ProgramData",
    16→    "/etc", "/usr", "/bin", "/sbin", "/var", "/root",
    17→)
    18→
    19→
    20→def _get_safe_dirs() -> list[Path]:
    21→    """Lazily load safe directories from config."""
    22→    global _SAFE_DIRS
    23→    if _SAFE_DIRS is None:
    24→        from ..config import (
    25→            COMFYUI_DATABASE, PROJECT_DIR, SESSIONS_DIR, WORKFLOWS_DIR,
    26→        )
    27→        _SAFE_DIRS = [
    28→            COMFYUI_DATABASE.resolve(),
    29→            PROJECT_DIR.resolve(),
    30→            SESSIONS_DIR.resolve(),
    31→            WORKFLOWS_DIR.resolve(),
    32→        ]
    33→    return _SAFE_DIRS
    34→
    35→
    36→def validate_path(path_str: str, *, must_exist: bool = False) -> str | None:
    37→    """Validate a file path is safe for tool access.
    38→
    39→    Returns None if valid, or an error message string if invalid.
    40→    Rejects path traversal attacks and access to system directories.
    41→    """
    42→    try:
    43→        p = Path(path_str).resolve()
    44→    except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
    45→        return f"Invalid path: {e}"
    46→
    47→    # Block system directories
    48→    p_str = str(p)
    49→    for prefix in _BLOCKED_PREFIXES:
    50→        if p_str.startswith(prefix):
    51→            return "Access denied: path is in a protected system directory"
    52→
    53→    # Check against allowed directories
    54→    safe_dirs = _get_safe_dirs()
    55→    in_safe_dir = any(
    56→        p_str.startswith(str(sd)) for sd in safe_dirs
    57→    )
    58→    # Also allow temp directories (pytest tmp_path, system temp)
    59→    import tempfile
    60→    temp_dir = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()).resolve()
    61→    if p_str.startswith(str(temp_dir)):
    62→        in_safe_dir = True
    63→
    64→    if not in_safe_dir:
    65→        return (
    66→            f"Access denied: path '{path_str}' is outside allowed directories. "
    67→            f"Allowed: ComfyUI database, project dir, sessions, workflows."
    68→        )
    69→
    70→    if must_exist and not p.exists():
    71→        return f"File not found: {path_str}"
    72→
    73→    return None
    74→
    75→
    76→def to_json(obj, **kwargs) -> str:
    77→    """Serialize to JSON with deterministic key ordering."""
    78→    kwargs.setdefault("sort_keys", True)
    79→    return _json.dumps(obj, **kwargs)
    80→

1→"""Tool registry for the ComfyUI SUPER DUPER Agent.
     2→
     3→Each tool module exports:
     4→  TOOLS: list[dict]    -- Anthropic tool schemas
     5→  handle(name, input)  -- Execute a tool call, return result string
     6→
     7→Intelligence layers (41 tools) + Brain layer (20 tools) = 61 tools total.
     8→Brain tools are lazily imported to avoid circular dependencies
     9→(brain modules import _util from this package).
    10→"""
    11→
    12→import logging
    13→
    14→from . import comfy_api, comfy_inspect, workflow_parse, workflow_patch, comfy_execute, comfy_discover, session_tools, workflow_templates, civitai_api, model_compat
    15→
    16→log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    17→
    18→_MODULES = (comfy_api, comfy_inspect, workflow_parse, workflow_patch, comfy_execute, comfy_discover, session_tools, workflow_templates, civitai_api, model_compat)
    19→
    20→# Intelligence layer tool schemas
    21→_LAYER_TOOLS: list[dict] = []
    22→for _mod in _MODULES:
    23→    _LAYER_TOOLS.extend(_mod.TOOLS)
    24→
    25→# Map tool name -> handler module (intelligence layers)
    26→_HANDLERS = {}
    27→for _mod in _MODULES:
    28→    for _tool in _mod.TOOLS:
    29→        _HANDLERS[_tool["name"]] = _mod
    30→
    31→# Brain tools are loaded lazily to break the circular import
    32→_brain_loaded = False
    33→_BRAIN_TOOL_NAMES: set[str] = set()
    34→
    35→
    36→def _ensure_brain():
    37→    """Lazily load brain layer tools."""
    38→    global _brain_loaded, _BRAIN_TOOL_NAMES
    39→    if _brain_loaded:
    40→        return
    41→    from ..brain import ALL_BRAIN_TOOLS
    42→    _BRAIN_TOOL_NAMES.update(t["name"] for t in ALL_BRAIN_TOOLS)
    43→    _brain_loaded = True
    44→
    45→
    46→def _get_all_tools() -> list[dict]:
    47→    """Get all tool schemas (intelligence + brain layers)."""
    48→    _ensure_brain()
    49→    from ..brain import ALL_BRAIN_TOOLS
    50→    return _LAYER_TOOLS + list(ALL_BRAIN_TOOLS)
    51→
    52→
    53→# Public API — ALL_TOOLS is a property-like accessor
    54→class _ToolList(list):
    55→    """Lazy tool list that includes brain tools on first access."""
    56→    _initialized = False
    57→
    58→    def _init_once(self):
    59→        if not self._initialized:
    60→            self._initialized = True
    61→            self.extend(_LAYER_TOOLS)
    62→            try:
    63→                from ..brain import ALL_BRAIN_TOOLS
    64→                self.extend(ALL_BRAIN_TOOLS)
    65→            except ImportError:
    66→                log.warning("Brain layer not available")
    67→
    68→    def __iter__(self):
    69→        self._init_once()
    70→        return super().__iter__()
    71→
    72→    def __len__(self):
    73→        self._init_once()
    74→        return super().__len__()
    75→
    76→    def __getitem__(self, idx):
    77→        self._init_once()
    78→        return super().__getitem__(idx)
    79→
    80→
    81→ALL_TOOLS = _ToolList()
    82→
    83→
    84→def handle(name: str, tool_input: dict, *, session_id: str | None = None) -> str:
    85→    """Dispatch a tool call to the right handler.
    86→
    87→    Args:
    88→        name: Tool name to dispatch.
    89→        tool_input: Tool arguments dict.
    90→        session_id: Optional session ID for workflow state isolation.
    91→                    Currently unused (default session), but enables future
    92→                    multi-session MCP usage.
    93→    """
    94→    # Check brain tools (lazy loaded)
    95→    _ensure_brain()
    96→    if name in _BRAIN_TOOL_NAMES:
    97→        from ..brain import handle as handle_brain
    98→        return handle_brain(name, tool_input)
    99→
   100→    # Intelligence layer tools
   101→    mod = _HANDLERS.get(name)
   102→    if mod is None:
   103→        log.warning("Unknown tool called: %s", name)

1→"""ComfyUI HTTP API tools.
     2→
     3→Wraps the ComfyUI REST API as Agent SDK tools so the agent can
     4→query the running ComfyUI instance for node info, system stats,
     5→queue status, and execution history.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→import httpx
     9→
    10→from ..circuit_breaker import COMFYUI_BREAKER
    11→from ..config import COMFYUI_URL
    12→from ._util import to_json
    13→
    14→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    15→# Tool schemas (Anthropic tool-use format)
    16→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    17→
    18→TOOLS: list[dict] = [
    19→    {
    20→        "name": "is_comfyui_running",
    21→        "description": (
    22→            "Check if ComfyUI is running and reachable. "
    23→            "Call this first before using other ComfyUI tools."
    24→        ),
    25→        "input_schema": {
    26→            "type": "object",
    27→            "properties": {},
    28→            "required": [],
    29→        },
    30→    },
    31→    {
    32→        "name": "get_all_nodes",
    33→        "description": (
    34→            "Get registered node types in ComfyUI via GET /object_info. "
    35→            "Use format='names_only' (just class_type names) or "
    36→            "'summary' (name+category) to control response size. "
    37→            "Use 'full' for complete input/output schemas. "
    38→            "Prefer get_node_info for a specific node."
    39→        ),
    40→        "input_schema": {
    41→            "type": "object",
    42→            "properties": {
    43→                "category_filter": {
    44→                    "type": "string",
    45→                    "description": (
    46→                        "Optional substring to filter nodes by category "
    47→                        "(e.g. 'sampling', 'loaders', 'image'). "
    48→                        "Case-insensitive."
    49→                    ),
    50→                },
    51→                "name_filter": {
    52→                    "type": "string",
    53→                    "description": (
    54→                        "Optional substring to filter nodes by class_type name "
    55→                        "(e.g. 'KSampler', 'ControlNet'). Case-insensitive."
    56→                    ),
    57→                },
    58→                "format": {
    59→                    "type": "string",
    60→                    "enum": ["names_only", "summary", "full"],
    61→                    "description": (
    62→                        "Response format. 'names_only': just class_type names (smallest). "
    63→                        "'summary': name + category + display_name (default). "
    64→                        "'full': includes input types and output types."
    65→                    ),
    66→                },
    67→            },
    68→            "required": [],
    69→        },
    70→    },
    71→    {
    72→        "name": "get_node_info",
    73→        "description": (
    74→            "Get detailed info for a specific ComfyUI node type: "
    75→            "its required/optional inputs with types and defaults, "
    76→            "output types, category, and description. "
    77→            "Use the exact class_type name (e.g. 'KSampler', 'CLIPTextEncode')."
    78→        ),
    79→        "input_schema": {
    80→            "type": "object",
    81→            "properties": {
    82→                "node_type": {
    83→                    "type": "string",
    84→                    "description": "Exact class_type name of the node.",
    85→                },
    86→            },
    87→            "required": ["node_type"],
    88→        },
    89→    },
    90→    {
    91→        "name": "get_system_stats",
    92→        "description": (
    93→            "Get ComfyUI system stats: GPU info, VRAM usage, "
    94→            "Python version, and currently loaded models."
    95→        ),
    96→        "input_schema": {
    97→            "type": "object",
    98→            "properties": {},
    99→            "required": [],
   100→        },
   101→    },
   102→    {
   103→        "name": "get_queue_status",
   104→        "description": (
   105→            "Get the current ComfyUI queue: running prompts and pending items."
   106→        ),
   107→        "input_schema": {
   108→            "type": "object",
   109→            "properties": {},
   110→            "required": [],
   111→        },
   112→    },
   113→    {
   114→        "name": "get_history",
   115→        "description": (
   116→            "Get execution history from ComfyUI. Optionally filter by prompt_id. "
   117→            "Returns outputs (images, videos) and execution status."
   118→        ),
   119→        "input_schema": {
   120→            "type": "object",
   121→            "properties": {
   122→                "prompt_id": {
   123→                    "type": "string",
   124→                    "description": "Specific prompt ID to look up. Omit for recent history.",
   125→                },
   126→                "max_items": {
   127→                    "type": "integer",
   128→                    "description": "Max number of history items to return (default 5).",
   129→                },
   130→            },
   131→            "required": [],
   132→        },
   133→    },
   134→]
   135→
   136→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   137→# HTTP helpers
   138→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   139→
   140→_TIMEOUT = 15.0
   141→
   142→
   143→def _get(path: str, timeout: float = _TIMEOUT) -> dict:
   144→    """GET request to ComfyUI, returns parsed JSON.
   145→
   146→    Raises httpx.ConnectError or httpx.HTTPStatusError on failure.
   147→    Circuit breaker tracks failures and fast-fails when ComfyUI is down.
   148→    """
   149→    breaker = COMFYUI_BREAKER()
   150→    if not breaker.allow_request():
   151→        raise httpx.ConnectError(
   152→            f"Circuit breaker open — ComfyUI at {COMFYUI_URL} has been unreachable. "
   153→            f"Will retry in {breaker.recovery_timeout:.0f}s."
   154→        )
   155→    try:
   156→        with httpx.Client() as client:
   157→            resp = client.get(f"{COMFYUI_URL}{path}", timeout=timeout)
   158→            resp.raise_for_status()
   159→            breaker.record_success()
   160→            return resp.json()
   161→    except (httpx.ConnectError, httpx.TimeoutException) as e:
   162→        breaker.record_failure()
   163→        raise httpx.ConnectError(str(e)) from e
   164→
   165→
   166→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   167→# Handlers
   168→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   169→
   170→def _handle_is_running() -> str:
   171→    try:
   172→        stats = _get("/system_stats", timeout=5.0)
   173→        devices = stats.get("devices", [])
   174→        gpu = devices[0].get("name", "unknown") if devices else "no GPU detected"
   175→        py_ver = stats.get("system", {}).get("python_version", "unknown")
   176→        return to_json({
   177→            "running": True,
   178→            "url": COMFYUI_URL,
   179→            "gpu": gpu,
   180→            "python": py_ver,
   181→        })
   182→    except Exception as e:
   183→        return to_json({
   184→            "running": False,
   185→            "url": COMFYUI_URL,
   186→            "error": str(e),
   187→        })
   188→
   189→
   190→def _handle_get_all_nodes(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   191→    cat_filter = (tool_input.get("category_filter") or "").lower()
   192→    name_filter = (tool_input.get("name_filter") or "").lower()
   193→    fmt = tool_input.get("format", "summary")
   194→
   195→    all_info = _get("/object_info", timeout=30.0)
   196→
   197→    # Apply filters
   198→    filtered_names = []
   199→    for name in sorted(all_info.keys()):
   200→        info = all_info[name]
   201→        cat = (info.get("category") or "").lower()
   202→        if cat_filter and cat_filter not in cat:
   203→            continue
   204→        if name_filter and name_filter not in name.lower():
   205→            continue
   206→        filtered_names.append(name)
   207→
   208→    # Format output based on requested detail level
   209→    if fmt == "names_only":
   210→        return to_json({
   211→            "count": len(filtered_names),
   212→            "nodes": filtered_names,
   213→        })
   214→
   215→    if fmt == "full":
   216→        nodes = {}
   217→        for name in filtered_names:
   218→            info = all_info[name]
   219→            nodes[name] = {
   220→                "category": info.get("category", ""),
   221→                "display_name": info.get("display_name", name),
   222→                "description": info.get("description", ""),
   223→                "input_types": list((info.get("input", {}).get("required", {})).keys()),
   224→                "output_types": info.get("output", []),
   225→            }
   226→        return to_json({"count": len(nodes), "nodes": nodes})
   227→
   228→    # Default: summary (name + category + display_name)
   229→    nodes = {}
   230→    for name in filtered_names:
   231→        info = all_info[name]
   232→        nodes[name] = {
   233→            "category": info.get("category", ""),
   234→            "display_name": info.get("display_name", name),
   235→        }
   236→    return to_json({
   237→        "count": len(nodes),
   238→        "nodes": nodes,
   239→        "hint": "Use format='names_only' for smaller response, or get_node_info for details on a specific node.",
   240→    })
   241→
   242→
   243→def _handle_get_node_info(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   244→    node_type = tool_input["node_type"]
   245→    all_info = _get(f"/object_info/{node_type}", timeout=10.0)
   246→
   247→    info = all_info.get(node_type)
   248→    if not info:
   249→        # Try case-insensitive search
   250→        all_nodes = _get("/object_info", timeout=30.0)
   251→        matches = [n for n in all_nodes if n.lower() == node_type.lower()]
   252→        if matches:
   253→            info = all_nodes[matches[0]]
   254→            node_type = matches[0]
   255→        else:
   256→            # Suggest similar names
   257→            similar = [n for n in all_nodes if node_type.lower() in n.lower()][:10]
   258→            return to_json({
   259→                "error": f"Node type '{node_type}' not found.",
   260→                "similar_nodes": similar,
   261→            })
   262→
   263→    return to_json({
   264→        "class_type": node_type,
   265→        "display_name": info.get("display_name", node_type),
   266→        "category": info.get("category", ""),
   267→        "description": info.get("description", ""),
   268→        "input": info.get("input", {}),
   269→        "output": info.get("output", []),
   270→        "output_name": info.get("output_name", []),
   271→        "output_is_list": info.get("output_is_list", []),
   272→    })
   273→
   274→
   275→def _handle_get_system_stats() -> str:
   276→    stats = _get("/system_stats", timeout=5.0)
   277→    return to_json(stats)
   278→
   279→
   280→def _handle_get_queue() -> str:
   281→    queue = _get("/queue", timeout=5.0)
   282→    running = queue.get("queue_running", [])
   283→    pending = queue.get("queue_pending", [])
   284→    return to_json({
   285→        "running_count": len(running),
   286→        "pending_count": len(pending),
   287→        "running": [{"prompt_id": r[1]} for r in running] if running else [],
   288→        "pending": [{"prompt_id": p[1]} for p in pending] if pending else [],
   289→    })
   290→
   291→
   292→def _handle_get_history(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   293→    prompt_id = tool_input.get("prompt_id")
   294→    max_items = tool_input.get("max_items", 5)
   295→
   296→    if prompt_id:
   297→        history = _get(f"/history/{prompt_id}", timeout=10.0)
   298→    else:
   299→        history = _get("/history", timeout=10.0)
   300→
   301→    # Trim to max_items
   302→    if not prompt_id and len(history) > max_items:
   303→        # History keys are prompt IDs; take most recent
   304→        keys = list(history.keys())[-max_items:]
   305→        history = {k: history[k] for k in keys}
   306→
   307→    # Summarize outputs
   308→    result = {}
   309→    for pid, entry in history.items():
   310→        outputs_summary = []
   311→        for node_id, node_out in entry.get("outputs", {}).items():
   312→            for img in node_out.get("images", []):
   313→                outputs_summary.append({
   314→                    "type": "image",
   315→                    "filename": img.get("filename"),
   316→                })
   317→            for vid in node_out.get("gifs", []):
   318→                outputs_summary.append({
   319→                    "type": "video",
   320→                    "filename": vid.get("filename"),
   321→                })
   322→        status_info = entry.get("status", {})
   323→        result[pid] = {
   324→            "status": status_info.get("status_str", "unknown"),
   325→            "completed": status_info.get("completed", False),
   326→            "outputs": outputs_summary,
   327→        }
   328→
   329→    return to_json(result)
   330→
   331→
   332→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   333→# Dispatch
   334→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   335→
   336→def handle(name: str, tool_input: dict) -> str:
   337→    """Execute a comfy_api tool call."""
   338→    try:
   339→        if name == "is_comfyui_running":
   340→            return _handle_is_running()
   341→        elif name == "get_all_nodes":
   342→            return _handle_get_all_nodes(tool_input)
   343→        elif name == "get_node_info":
   344→            return _handle_get_node_info(tool_input)
   345→        elif name == "get_system_stats":
   346→            return _handle_get_system_stats()
   347→        elif name == "get_queue_status":
   348→            return _handle_get_queue()
   349→        elif name == "get_history":
   350→            return _handle_get_history(tool_input)
   351→        else:
   352→            return to_json({"error": f"Unknown tool: {name}"})
   353→    except httpx.ConnectError:
   354→        return to_json({
   355→            "error": f"Could not connect to ComfyUI at {COMFYUI_URL}. Is it running?",
   356→        })
   357→    except httpx.HTTPStatusError as e:
   358→        return to_json({
   359→            "error": f"HTTP {e.response.status_code}: {e.response.text[:200]}",
   360→        })
   361→    except Exception as e:
   362→        return to_json({"error": str(e)})

1→"""Filesystem inspection tools.
     2→
     3→Reads the local ComfyUI installation to discover installed
     4→custom nodes, models, and their on-disk details — without
     5→needing ComfyUI to be running.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→from pathlib import Path
     9→
    10→from ..config import CUSTOM_NODES_DIR, MODELS_DIR
    11→from ._util import to_json
    12→
    13→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    14→# Tool schemas
    15→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16→
    17→TOOLS: list[dict] = [
    18→    {
    19→        "name": "list_custom_nodes",
    20→        "description": (
    21→            "List all installed ComfyUI custom node packs by scanning "
    22→            "the Custom_Nodes directory. Returns pack names, whether they "
    23→            "have a README or requirements.txt, and node count if detectable."
    24→        ),
    25→        "input_schema": {
    26→            "type": "object",
    27→            "properties": {
    28→                "name_filter": {
    29→                    "type": "string",
    30→                    "description": "Optional substring filter on pack name (case-insensitive).",
    31→                },
    32→            },
    33→            "required": [],
    34→        },
    35→    },
    36→    {
    37→        "name": "list_models",
    38→        "description": (
    39→            "List model files in a specific model subdirectory "
    40→            "(e.g. 'checkpoints', 'loras', 'controlnet', 'vae'). "
    41→            "Use format='names_only' for just filenames, "
    42→            "'summary' (default) for name+size, 'full' for all details."
    43→        ),
    44→        "input_schema": {
    45→            "type": "object",
    46→            "properties": {
    47→                "model_type": {
    48→                    "type": "string",
    49→                    "description": (
    50→                        "Subdirectory under models/ to scan. "
    51→                        "Common: checkpoints, loras, vae, controlnet, "
    52→                        "clip, upscale_models, embeddings, unet, diffusion_models."
    53→                    ),
    54→                },
    55→                "format": {
    56→                    "type": "string",
    57→                    "enum": ["names_only", "summary", "full"],
    58→                    "description": (
    59→                        "'names_only': just filenames. "
    60→                        "'summary': name + human-readable size (default). "
    61→                        "'full': name + size + size_bytes."
    62→                    ),
    63→                },
    64→            },
    65→            "required": ["model_type"],
    66→        },
    67→    },
    68→    {
    69→        "name": "get_models_summary",
    70→        "description": (
    71→            "Get a summary of all model directories: "
    72→            "which types exist and how many files each contains."
    73→        ),
    74→        "input_schema": {
    75→            "type": "object",
    76→            "properties": {},
    77→            "required": [],
    78→        },
    79→    },
    80→    {
    81→        "name": "read_node_source",
    82→        "description": (
    83→            "Read the source code of a custom node pack's entry point "
    84→            "(__init__.py) to understand what nodes it registers. "
    85→            "Useful for discovering NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS."
    86→        ),
    87→        "input_schema": {
    88→            "type": "object",
    89→            "properties": {
    90→                "node_pack": {
    91→                    "type": "string",
    92→                    "description": "Name of the custom node pack directory.",
    93→                },
    94→                "max_lines": {
    95→                    "type": "integer",
    96→                    "description": "Maximum lines to read (default 200).",
    97→                },
    98→            },
    99→            "required": ["node_pack"],
   100→        },
   101→    },
   102→]
   103→
   104→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   105→# Helpers
   106→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   107→
   108→_MODEL_EXTENSIONS = {".safetensors", ".ckpt", ".pt", ".pth", ".bin", ".gguf", ".onnx"}
   109→
   110→
   111→def _human_size(nbytes: int) -> str:
   112→    """Format bytes as human-readable size."""
   113→    for unit in ("B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"):
   114→        if abs(nbytes) < 1024:
   115→            return f"{nbytes:.1f} {unit}"
   116→        nbytes /= 1024
   117→    return f"{nbytes:.1f} PB"
   118→
   119→
   120→def _is_node_pack(path: Path) -> bool:
   121→    """Check if a directory looks like a custom node pack."""
   122→    if not path.is_dir():
   123→        return False
   124→    name = path.name
   125→    # Skip __pycache__, hidden dirs, temp dirs
   126→    if name.startswith((".", "__", "tmp")):
   127→        return False
   128→    # Must have Python files
   129→    return any(path.glob("*.py"))
   130→
   131→
   132→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   133→# Handlers
   134→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   135→
   136→def _handle_list_custom_nodes(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   137→    name_filter = (tool_input.get("name_filter") or "").lower()
   138→
   139→    if not CUSTOM_NODES_DIR.exists():
   140→        return to_json({
   141→            "error": f"Custom nodes directory not found: {CUSTOM_NODES_DIR}",
   142→        })
   143→
   144→    packs = []
   145→    for item in sorted(CUSTOM_NODES_DIR.iterdir()):
   146→        if not _is_node_pack(item):
   147→            continue
   148→        if name_filter and name_filter not in item.name.lower():
   149→            continue
   150→
   151→        info = {"name": item.name}
   152→
   153→        # Check for README
   154→        for readme_name in ("README.md", "readme.md", "README.rst"):
   155→            if (item / readme_name).exists():
   156→                info["has_readme"] = True
   157→                break
   158→
   159→        # Check for requirements
   160→        info["has_requirements"] = (item / "requirements.txt").exists()
   161→
   162→        # Try to count registered nodes from __init__.py
   163→        init_file = item / "__init__.py"
   164→        if init_file.exists():
   165→            try:
   166→                content = init_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
   167→                if "NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS" in content:
   168→                    info["registers_nodes"] = True
   169→            except Exception:
   170→                pass
   171→
   172→        packs.append(info)
   173→
   174→    return to_json({
   175→        "directory": str(CUSTOM_NODES_DIR),
   176→        "count": len(packs),
   177→        "packs": packs,
   178→    })
   179→
   180→
   181→def _handle_list_models(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   182→    model_type = tool_input["model_type"]
   183→    fmt = tool_input.get("format", "summary")
   184→    model_dir = MODELS_DIR / model_type
   185→
   186→    if not model_dir.exists():
   187→        # List available types
   188→        available = [d.name for d in MODELS_DIR.iterdir() if d.is_dir()]
   189→        return to_json({
   190→            "error": f"Model directory '{model_type}' not found.",
   191→            "available_types": sorted(available),
   192→        })
   193→
   194→    # Collect model paths
   195→    model_files = sorted(
   196→        f for f in model_dir.rglob("*")
   197→        if f.is_file() and f.suffix.lower() in _MODEL_EXTENSIONS
   198→    )
   199→
   200→    base = {
   201→        "model_type": model_type,
   202→        "directory": str(model_dir),
   203→        "count": len(model_files),
   204→    }
   205→
   206→    if fmt == "names_only":
   207→        base["models"] = [str(f.relative_to(model_dir)) for f in model_files]
   208→        return to_json(base)
   209→
   210→    if fmt == "full":
   211→        base["models"] = [
   212→            {
   213→                "name": str(f.relative_to(model_dir)),
   214→                "size": _human_size(f.stat().st_size),
   215→                "size_bytes": f.stat().st_size,
   216→            }
   217→            for f in model_files
   218→        ]
   219→        return to_json(base)
   220→
   221→    # Default: summary (name + human-readable size)
   222→    base["models"] = [
   223→        {"name": str(f.relative_to(model_dir)), "size": _human_size(f.stat().st_size)}
   224→        for f in model_files
   225→    ]
   226→    return to_json(base)
   227→
   228→
   229→def _handle_get_models_summary() -> str:
   230→    if not MODELS_DIR.exists():
   231→        return to_json({"error": f"Models directory not found: {MODELS_DIR}"})
   232→
   233→    summary = {}
   234→    for d in sorted(MODELS_DIR.iterdir()):
   235→        if not d.is_dir():
   236→            continue
   237→        count = sum(
   238→            1 for f in d.rglob("*")
   239→            if f.is_file() and f.suffix.lower() in _MODEL_EXTENSIONS
   240→        )
   241→        if count > 0:
   242→            summary[d.name] = count
   243→
   244→    return to_json({
   245→        "directory": str(MODELS_DIR),
   246→        "types": summary,
   247→        "total_types": len(summary),
   248→    })
   249→
   250→
   251→def _handle_read_node_source(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   252→    node_pack = tool_input["node_pack"]
   253→    max_lines = tool_input.get("max_lines", 200)
   254→
   255→    pack_dir = CUSTOM_NODES_DIR / node_pack
   256→    # Prevent path traversal (e.g., "../../etc/passwd")
   257→    try:
   258→        resolved = pack_dir.resolve()
   259→        if not str(resolved).startswith(str(CUSTOM_NODES_DIR.resolve())):
   260→            return to_json({"error": "Access denied: path escapes Custom_Nodes directory."})
   261→    except (OSError, ValueError):
   262→        return to_json({"error": f"Invalid node pack name: {node_pack}"})
   263→
   264→    if not pack_dir.exists():
   265→        # Suggest similar names
   266→        available = [
   267→            d.name for d in CUSTOM_NODES_DIR.iterdir()
   268→            if _is_node_pack(d) and node_pack.lower() in d.name.lower()
   269→        ]
   270→        return to_json({
   271→            "error": f"Node pack '{node_pack}' not found.",
   272→            "similar": available[:10],
   273→        })
   274→
   275→    init_file = pack_dir / "__init__.py"
   276→    if not init_file.exists():
   277→        # Try to find main Python files
   278→        py_files = sorted(pack_dir.glob("*.py"))
   279→        return to_json({
   280→            "error": f"No __init__.py in '{node_pack}'.",
   281→            "python_files": [f.name for f in py_files[:20]],
   282→        })
   283→
   284→    try:
   285→        lines = init_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
   286→        truncated = len(lines) > max_lines
   287→        source = "\n".join(lines[:max_lines])
   288→    except Exception as e:
   289→        return to_json({"error": f"Could not read file: {e}"})
   290→
   291→    return to_json({
   292→        "pack": node_pack,
   293→        "file": str(init_file),
   294→        "total_lines": len(lines),
   295→        "truncated": truncated,
   296→        "source": source,
   297→    })
   298→
   299→
   300→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   301→# Dispatch
   302→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   303→
   304→def handle(name: str, tool_input: dict) -> str:
   305→    """Execute a comfy_inspect tool call."""
   306→    try:
   307→        if name == "list_custom_nodes":
   308→            return _handle_list_custom_nodes(tool_input)
   309→        elif name == "list_models":
   310→            return _handle_list_models(tool_input)
   311→        elif name == "get_models_summary":
   312→            return _handle_get_models_summary()
   313→        elif name == "read_node_source":
   314→            return _handle_read_node_source(tool_input)
   315→        else:
   316→            return to_json({"error": f"Unknown tool: {name}"})
   317→    except Exception as e:
   318→        return to_json({"error": str(e)})
   319→

   247→def _build_node_to_pack() -> dict[str, dict]:
   248→    """Build reverse index: node_type -> {url, title, node_types}."""
   249→    if _cache["node_to_pack"] is not None:
   250→        return _cache["node_to_pack"]
   251→
   252→    ext_map = _load_extension_map()
   253→    index = {}
   254→    for url, entry in sorted(ext_map.items()):  # He2025: sorted iteration for deterministic collision resolution
   255→        if not isinstance(entry, list) or len(entry) < 2:
   256→            continue
   257→        node_types = entry[0] if isinstance(entry[0], list) else []
   258→        meta = entry[1] if isinstance(entry[1], dict) else {}
   259→        title = meta.get("title_aux", url.split("/")[-1] if "/" in url else url)
   260→
   261→        pack_info = {"url": url, "title": title, "node_count": len(node_types)}
   262→        for nt in node_types:
   263→            index[nt] = pack_info
   264→
   265→    _cache["node_to_pack"] = index
   266→    return index

   312→    query = tool_input["query"]
   313→    by = tool_input.get("by", "name")
   314→    max_results = tool_input.get("max_results", 10)
   315→
   316→    if by == "node_type":

   322→def _search_by_node_type(query: str, max_results: int) -> str:
   323→    """Find which pack provides a specific node type."""
   324→    index = _build_node_to_pack()
   325→
   326→    if not index:
   327→        return to_json({
   328→            "error": (
   329→                "ComfyUI Manager not found. Install it from "
   330→                "https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager"
   331→            ),
   332→        })
   333→
   334→    # Exact match first
   335→    if query in index:
   336→        pack = index[query]
   337→        return to_json({
   338→            "match": "exact",
   339→            "node_type": query,
   340→            "pack": {
   341→                "title": pack["title"],
   342→                "url": pack["url"],
   343→                "node_count": pack["node_count"],
   344→                "installed": _is_pack_installed(pack["url"]),
   345→            },
   346→        })
   347→
   348→    # Fuzzy match — case-insensitive substring, sorted for determinism
   349→    query_lower = query.lower()
   350→    matches = []
   351→    seen_packs = set()
   352→    for nt, pack in sorted(index.items()):
   353→        if query_lower in nt.lower() and pack["url"] not in seen_packs:
   354→            seen_packs.add(pack["url"])
   355→            matches.append({
   356→                "node_type": nt,
   357→                "pack_title": pack["title"],
   358→                "pack_url": pack["url"],
   359→                "installed": _is_pack_installed(pack["url"]),
   360→            })
   361→            if len(matches) >= max_results:
   362→                break
   363→
   364→    if not matches:
   365→        return to_json({
   366→            "match": "none",
   367→            "node_type": query,
   368→            "message": f"No pack found providing '{query}'. Check the spelling.",
   369→            "total_known_types": len(index),
   370→        })
   371→
   372→    return to_json({
   373→        "match": "fuzzy",
   374→        "query": query,
   375→        "results": matches,
   376→        "total_matches": len(matches),
   377→    })

   380→def _search_by_name(query: str, max_results: int) -> str:
   381→    """Search custom node packs by title/description/author."""
   382→    packs = _load_custom_nodes()
   383→
   384→    if not packs:
   385→        return to_json({
   386→            "error": (
   387→                "ComfyUI Manager not found. Install it from "
   388→                "https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager"
   389→            ),
   390→        })
   391→
   392→    query_lower = query.lower()
   393→    query_words = query_lower.split()
   394→    scored = []
   395→
   396→    for pack in packs:
   397→        title = pack.get("title", "")
   398→        desc = pack.get("description", "")
   399→        author = pack.get("author", "")
   400→        searchable = f"{title} {desc} {author}".lower()
   401→
   402→        # Score: all words match > some words match
   403→        word_hits = sum(1 for w in query_words if w in searchable)
   404→        if word_hits == 0:
   405→            continue
   406→
   407→        # Boost exact title match
   408→        score = word_hits
   409→        if query_lower in title.lower():
   410→            score += 10
   411→
   412→        ref = pack.get("reference", "")
   413→        scored.append((score, {
   414→            "title": title,
   415→            "author": author,
   416→            "description": desc[:200] if desc else "",
   417→            "url": ref,
   418→            "install_type": pack.get("install_type", ""),
   419→            "installed": _is_pack_installed(ref) if ref else False,
   420→        }))
   421→
   422→    scored.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1].get("title", "")))
   423→    results = [r for _, r in scored[:max_results]]
   424→
   425→    return to_json({
   426→        "query": query,
   427→        "results": results,
   428→        "total_matches": len(scored),
   429→        "showing": len(results),
   430→    })

   448→
   449→    if not models:

   454→            ),
   455→        })
   456→
   457→    query_lower = query.lower()

   459→    scored = []
   460→
   461→    for model in models:

   463→        mtype = model.get("type", "")
   464→        base = model.get("base", "")
   465→        desc = model.get("description", "")
   466→        searchable = f"{name} {mtype} {base} {desc}".lower()
   467→
   468→        # Apply type filter if given
   469→        if model_type and model_type.lower() not in mtype.lower():
   470→            continue
   471→
   472→        word_hits = sum(1 for w in query_words if w in searchable)
   473→        if word_hits == 0:
   474→            continue
   475→
   476→        score = word_hits
   477→        if query_lower in name.lower():
   478→            score += 10
   479→
   480→        filename = model.get("filename", "")

   482→
   483→        scored.append((score, {

   488→            "filename": filename,
   489→            "url": model.get("url", ""),

   491→            "save_path": save_path,

   496→    results = [r for _, r in scored[:max_results]]

   498→    return to_json({

   508→def _search_huggingface(query: str, model_type: str | None, max_results: int) -> str:
   509→    """Search HuggingFace Hub API for models."""
   510→    params = {
   511→        "search": query,
   512→        "sort": "downloads",
   513→        "direction": "-1",
   514→        "limit": max_results,
   515→    }
   516→
   517→    # Map model types to HuggingFace tags
   518→    if model_type:
   519→        type_tags = {
   520→            "checkpoint": "diffusers",
   521→            "lora": "lora",
   522→            "vae": "vae",
   523→            "controlnet": "controlnet",
   524→            "embedding": "textual-inversion",
   525→        }
   526→        tag = type_tags.get(model_type.lower())
   527→        if tag:
   528→            params["filter"] = tag
   529→
   530→    if not HUGGINGFACE_LIMITER().acquire(timeout=5.0):
   531→        return to_json({"error": "Rate limited — too many HuggingFace requests. Try again shortly."})
   532→
   533→    try:
   534→        with httpx.Client() as client:
   535→            resp = client.get(
   536→                "https://huggingface.co/api/models",
   537→                params=params,
   538→                timeout=15.0,
   539→            )
   540→            resp.raise_for_status()
   541→            data = resp.json()
   542→    except httpx.ConnectError:
   543→        return to_json({"error": "Could not reach HuggingFace API. Check your internet connection."})
   544→    except httpx.HTTPStatusError as e:
   545→        return to_json({"error": f"HuggingFace API returned {e.response.status_code}."})
   546→    except Exception as e:
   547→        return to_json({"error": f"HuggingFace search failed: {e}"})
   548→
   549→    results = []
   550→    for item in data:
   551→        model_id = item.get("modelId", item.get("id", ""))
   552→        results.append({
   553→            "name": model_id,
   554→            "author": model_id.split("/")[0] if "/" in model_id else "",
   555→            "downloads": item.get("downloads", 0),
   556→            "likes": item.get("likes", 0),
   557→            "tags": item.get("tags", [])[:5],
   558→            "url": f"https://huggingface.co/{model_id}",
   559→            "last_modified": item.get("lastModified", ""),
   560→        })
   561→
   562→    return to_json({
   563→        "source": "huggingface",
   564→        "query": query,
   565→        "type_filter": model_type,
   566→        "results": results,
   567→        "showing": len(results),
   568→    })

   571→def _handle_find_missing_nodes(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   572→    path_str = tool_input.get("path")
   573→
   574→    # Get workflow
   575→    if path_str:
   576→        path = Path(path_str)
   577→        if not path.exists():
   578→            return to_json({"error": f"File not found: {path_str}"})
   579→        try:
   580→            data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   581→        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
   582→            return to_json({"error": f"Invalid JSON: {e}"})
   583→
   584→        # Extract API-format nodes
   585→        if "nodes" in data and isinstance(data["nodes"], list):
   586→            prompt_data = data.get("extra", {}).get("prompt")
   587→            if prompt_data and isinstance(prompt_data, dict):
   588→                workflow = {
   589→                    k: v for k, v in prompt_data.items()
   590→                    if isinstance(v, dict) and "class_type" in v
   591→                }
   592→            else:
   593→                # UI-only: extract class_types from nodes array
   594→                workflow = {}
   595→                for node in data["nodes"]:
   596→                    nid = str(node.get("id", ""))
   597→                    ntype = node.get("type", "")
   598→                    if ntype:
   599→                        workflow[nid] = {"class_type": ntype, "inputs": {}}
   600→        else:
   601→            workflow = {
   602→                k: v for k, v in data.items()
   603→                if isinstance(v, dict) and "class_type" in v
   604→            }
   605→    else:
   606→        from .workflow_patch import get_current_workflow
   607→        workflow = get_current_workflow()
   608→        if workflow is None:
   609→            return to_json({
   610→                "error": (
   611→                    "No workflow loaded. Either provide a 'path' or load one "
   612→                    "with apply_workflow_patch first."
   613→                ),
   614→            })
   615→
   616→    # Collect unique class_types
   617→    class_types = set()
   618→    for node in workflow.values():
   619→        ct = node.get("class_type")
   620→        if ct:
   621→            class_types.add(ct)
   622→
   623→    if not class_types:
   624→        return to_json({"error": "No nodes found in workflow."})
   625→
   626→    # Check which are available in live ComfyUI
   627→    available = set()
   628→    try:
   629→        with httpx.Client() as client:
   630→            resp = client.get(f"{COMFYUI_URL}/object_info", timeout=15.0)
   631→            resp.raise_for_status()
   632→            object_info = resp.json()
   633→            available = set(object_info.keys())
   634→    except httpx.ConnectError:
   635→        return to_json({
   636→            "error": "ComfyUI not reachable. Start ComfyUI to check node availability.",
   637→        })
   638→    except Exception as e:
   639→        return to_json({"error": f"Could not fetch node info: {e}"})
   640→
   641→    # Classify
   642→    installed = sorted(class_types & available)
   643→    missing = sorted(class_types - available)
   644→
   645→    # Look up missing nodes in extension-node-map
   646→    index = _build_node_to_pack()
   647→    missing_report = []
   648→    packs_needed = {}  # url -> {title, nodes}
   649→
   650→    for node_type in missing:
   651→        pack_info = index.get(node_type)
   652→        if pack_info:
   653→            url = pack_info["url"]
   654→            if url not in packs_needed:
   655→                packs_needed[url] = {
   656→                    "title": pack_info["title"],
   657→                    "url": url,
   658→                    "installed": _is_pack_installed(url),
   659→                    "missing_nodes": [],
   660→                }
   661→            packs_needed[url]["missing_nodes"].append(node_type)
   662→
   663→            missing_report.append({
   664→                "node_type": node_type,
   665→                "pack_title": pack_info["title"],
   666→                "pack_url": url,
   667→                "pack_installed": _is_pack_installed(url),
   668→            })
   669→        else:
   670→            missing_report.append({
   671→                "node_type": node_type,
   672→                "pack_title": None,
   673→                "pack_url": None,
   674→                "message": "Not found in ComfyUI Manager registry.",
   675→            })
   676→
   677→    # Summary
   678→    if not missing:
   679→        return to_json({
   680→            "status": "all_installed",
   681→            "total_node_types": len(class_types),
   682→            "message": "All node types in this workflow are available.",
   683→        })
   684→
   685→    return to_json({
   686→        "status": "missing_nodes",
   687→        "total_node_types": len(class_types),
   688→        "installed_count": len(installed),
   689→        "missing_count": len(missing),
   690→        "missing_nodes": missing_report,
   691→        "packs_to_install": list(packs_needed.values()),
   692→        "install_hint": (
   693→            "Install missing packs via ComfyUI Manager or git clone into "
   694→            f"{CUSTOM_NODES_DIR}"
   695→        ),
   696→    })

   699→def _handle_get_install_instructions(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   700→    """Get install instructions for a node pack or model."""
   701→    query = tool_input["query"]
   702→    source = tool_input.get("source", "registry")
   703→
   704→    if source == "civitai":
   705→        return to_json({
   706→            "source": "civitai",
   707→            "query": query,
   708→            "instructions": (
   709→                f"To install a CivitAI model, use the CivitAI tools to find the "
   710→                f"model first (search_civitai), then download the file to the "
   711→                f"appropriate directory under {MODELS_DIR}. "
   712→                f"CivitAI models are typically .safetensors files."
   713→            ),
   714→            "steps": [
   715→                f"1. Use search_civitai to find '{query}' and get the download URL",
   716→                "2. Note the model type (checkpoint, lora, controlnet, etc.)",
   717→                f"3. Download to {MODELS_DIR}/<type>/ directory",
   718→                "4. Restart ComfyUI or refresh the model list",
   719→            ],
   720→        })
   721→
   722→    if source == "huggingface":
   723→        return to_json({
   724→            "source": "huggingface",
   725→            "query": query,
   726→            "instructions": (
   727→                f"To install a HuggingFace model, download the .safetensors file "
   728→                f"to the appropriate directory under {MODELS_DIR}."
   729→            ),
   730→            "steps": [
   731→                f"1. Use search_models with source='huggingface' to find '{query}'",
   732→                "2. Note the model type and download the .safetensors file",
   733→                f"3. Place in {MODELS_DIR}/<type>/ directory",
   734→                "4. Restart ComfyUI or refresh the model list",
   735→            ],
   736→        })
   737→
   738→    # Registry source — look up node packs and models
   739→    # Try node pack first (by node_type)
   740→    index = _build_node_to_pack()
   741→    if query in index:
   742→        pack = index[query]
   743→        url = pack["url"]
   744→        installed = _is_pack_installed(url)
   745→        folder = url.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1]
   746→        if folder.endswith(".git"):
   747→            folder = folder[:-4]
   748→        return to_json({
   749→            "source": "registry",
   750→            "type": "node_pack",
   751→            "query": query,
   752→            "pack_title": pack["title"],
   753→            "installed": installed,
   754→            "install_commands": [
   755→                f"cd {CUSTOM_NODES_DIR}",
   756→                f"git clone {url}",
   757→                f"pip install -r {CUSTOM_NODES_DIR / folder / 'requirements.txt'} "
   758→                f"(if exists)",
   759→                "Restart ComfyUI",
   760→            ] if not installed else [],
   761→            "message": "Already installed." if installed else f"Clone {url} into Custom_Nodes.",
   762→        })
   763→
   764→    # Try node pack by name search
   765→    packs = _load_custom_nodes()
   766→    query_lower = query.lower()
   767→    for pack in packs:
   768→        title = pack.get("title", "")
   769→        ref = pack.get("reference", "")
   770→        if query_lower in title.lower() or query_lower in ref.lower():
   771→            installed = _is_pack_installed(ref) if ref else False
   772→            folder = ref.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1] if ref else ""
   773→            if folder.endswith(".git"):
   774→                folder = folder[:-4]
   775→            return to_json({
   776→                "source": "registry",
   777→                "type": "node_pack",
   778→                "query": query,
   779→                "pack_title": title,
   780→                "installed": installed,
   781→                "install_commands": [
   782→                    f"cd {CUSTOM_NODES_DIR}",
   783→                    f"git clone {ref}",
   784→                    f"pip install -r {CUSTOM_NODES_DIR / folder / 'requirements.txt'} "
   785→                    f"(if exists)",
   786→                    "Restart ComfyUI",
   787→                ] if not installed and ref else [],
   788→                "message": "Already installed." if installed else f"Clone {ref} into Custom_Nodes.",
   789→            })
   790→
   791→    # Try model registry
   792→    models = _load_model_list()
   793→    for model in models:
   794→        name = model.get("name", "")
   795→        if query_lower in name.lower():
   796→            filename = model.get("filename", "")
   797→            save_path = model.get("save_path", "")
   798→            url = model.get("url", "")
   799→            installed = _is_model_installed(filename, save_path) if filename and save_path else False
   800→            return to_json({
   801→                "source": "registry",
   802→                "type": "model",
   803→                "query": query,
   804→                "model_name": name,
   805→                "installed": installed,
   806→                "install_commands": [
   807→                    f"Download: {url}",
   808→                    f"Save to: {MODELS_DIR / save_path / filename}",
   809→                    "Restart ComfyUI or refresh model list",
   810→                ] if not installed and url else [],
   811→                "message": "Already installed." if installed else f"Download {filename} to {save_path}/.",
   812→            })
   813→
   814→    return to_json({
   815→        "source": "registry",
   816→        "query": query,
   817→        "error": f"Could not find '{query}' in the registry. Try search_custom_nodes or search_models first.",
   818→    })
   819→
   820→
   821→def _clear_cache():
   822→    """Clear all in-memory caches, forcing reload from disk on next access."""
   823→    _cache["custom_nodes"] = None
   824→    _cache["extension_map"] = None
   825→    _cache["node_to_pack"] = None
   826→    _cache["model_list"] = None
   827→    _freshness["custom_nodes_loaded_at"] = None
   828→    _freshness["extension_map_loaded_at"] = None
   829→    _freshness["model_list_loaded_at"] = None
   830→
   831→
   832→def _file_age_info(path: Path) -> dict:
   833→    """Get age info for a file. Returns dict with exists, modified_at, age_s, age_human."""
   834→    if not path.exists():
   835→        return {"exists": False, "path": str(path)}
   836→
   837→    mtime = path.stat().st_mtime
   838→    age_s = time.time() - mtime
   839→    age_days = age_s / 86400
   840→
   841→    if age_days < 1:
   842→        age_human = f"{age_s / 3600:.1f} hours"
   843→    else:
   844→        age_human = f"{age_days:.1f} days"
   845→
   846→    if age_s > _WARN_THRESHOLD:
   847→        status = "very_stale"
   848→    elif age_s > _STALE_THRESHOLD:
   849→        status = "stale"
   850→    else:
   851→        status = "fresh"
   852→
   853→    return {
   854→        "exists": True,
   855→        "path": str(path),
   856→        "age_seconds": round(age_s),
   857→        "age_human": age_human,
   858→        "status": status,
   859→    }
   860→
   861→
   862→def _model_dir_stats() -> dict:
   863→    """Count model files by type in the models directory."""
   864→    if not MODELS_DIR.exists():
   865→        return {"exists": False, "path": str(MODELS_DIR)}
   866→
   867→    types = {}
   868→    for subdir in sorted(MODELS_DIR.iterdir()):
   869→        if subdir.is_dir():
   870→            count = sum(1 for f in subdir.iterdir() if f.is_file() and f.suffix in (
   871→                ".safetensors", ".ckpt", ".pt", ".pth", ".bin",
   872→            ))
   873→            if count > 0:
   874→                types[subdir.name] = count
   875→
   876→    return {
   877→        "exists": True,
   878→        "path": str(MODELS_DIR),
   879→        "types": types,
   880→        "total_files": sum(types.values()),
   881→    }
   882→
   883→
   884→def _handle_check_freshness(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   885→    """Check freshness of registry data and model files."""
   886→    if tool_input.get("refresh"):
   887→        _clear_cache()
   888→
   889→    # Check registry files
   890→    registry_files = {
   891→        "custom_node_list": _MANAGER_DIR / "custom-node-list.json",
   892→        "extension_node_map": _MANAGER_DIR / "extension-node-map.json",
   893→        "model_list": _MANAGER_DIR / "model-list.json",
   894→    }
   895→
   896→    registries = {}
   897→    any_stale = False
   898→    any_missing = False
   899→    for key, path in sorted(registry_files.items()):
   900→        info = _file_age_info(path)
   901→        registries[key] = info
   902→        if not info.get("exists"):
   903→            any_missing = True
   904→        elif info.get("status") in ("stale", "very_stale"):
   905→            any_stale = True
   906→
   907→    # Cache status
   908→    cache_status = {
   909→        "custom_nodes_cached": _cache["custom_nodes"] is not None,
   910→        "extension_map_cached": _cache["extension_map"] is not None,
   911→        "node_to_pack_cached": _cache["node_to_pack"] is not None,
   912→        "model_list_cached": _cache["model_list"] is not None,
   913→    }
   914→
   915→    # Model directory stats
   916→    models = _model_dir_stats()
   917→
   918→    # Build recommendations
   919→    recommendations = []
   920→    if any_missing:
   921→        recommendations.append(
   922→            "Install ComfyUI Manager to get registry data: "
   923→            "https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager"
   924→        )
   925→    if any_stale:
   926→        recommendations.append(
   927→            "Registry files are stale. Open ComfyUI Manager in the browser "
   928→            "and click 'Update ComfyUI Manager' to refresh."
   929→        )
   930→    if tool_input.get("refresh"):
   931→        recommendations.append("In-memory cache cleared. Next search will reload from disk.")
   932→
   933→    return to_json({
   934→        "registries": registries,
   935→        "cache": cache_status,
   936→        "models": models,
   937→        "manager_installed": _MANAGER_DIR.exists(),
   938→        "recommendations": recommendations,
   939→        "refreshed": bool(tool_input.get("refresh")),
   940→    })
   941→
   942→
   943→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   944→# Dispatch
   945→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   946→
   947→def handle(name: str, tool_input: dict) -> str:
   948→    """Execute a comfy_discover tool call."""
   949→    try:
   950→        if name == "search_custom_nodes":
   951→            return _handle_search_custom_nodes(tool_input)
   952→        elif name == "search_models":
   953→            return _handle_search_models(tool_input)
   954→        elif name == "find_missing_nodes":
   955→            return _handle_find_missing_nodes(tool_input)
   956→        elif name == "get_install_instructions":
   957→            return _handle_get_install_instructions(tool_input)
   958→        elif name == "check_registry_freshness":
   959→            return _handle_check_freshness(tool_input)
   960→        else:
   961→            return to_json({"error": f"Unknown tool: {name}"})
   962→    except Exception as e:
   963→        return to_json({"error": str(e)})
