1→"""CivitAI discovery — search trending models, LoRAs, ControlNets.
     2→
     3→The largest community hub for Stable Diffusion models. Public API,
     4→no authentication required for search. Complements ComfyUI Manager's
     5→curated registry with community ratings, download counts, and trending data.
     6→
     7→API reference: https://github.com/civitai/civitai/wiki/REST-API-Reference
     8→"""
     9→
    10→import logging
    11→import os
    12→import re
    13→
    14→import httpx
    15→
    16→from ..config import MODELS_DIR
    17→from ..rate_limiter import CIVITAI_LIMITER
    18→from ._util import to_json
    19→
    20→log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    21→
    22→CIVITAI_API = "https://civitai.com/api/v1"
    23→CIVITAI_API_KEY = os.getenv("CIVITAI_API_KEY")  # Optional — improves rate limits
    24→
    25→# Our lowercase types -> CivitAI API enum values
    26→_TYPE_MAP = {
    27→    "checkpoint": "Checkpoint",
    28→    "lora": "LORA",
    29→    "controlnet": "Controlnet",
    30→    "embedding": "TextualInversion",
    31→    "vae": "VAE",
    32→    "hypernetwork": "Hypernetwork",
    33→    "upscaler": "Upscaler",
    34→    "poses": "Poses",
    35→}
    36→
    37→# CivitAI type -> local model subdirectory
    38→_TYPE_TO_SUBDIR = {
    39→    "Checkpoint": "checkpoints",
    40→    "LORA": "loras",
    41→    "Controlnet": "controlnet",
    42→    "VAE": "vae",
    43→    "TextualInversion": "embeddings",
    44→    "Upscaler": "upscale_models",
    45→    "Hypernetwork": "hypernetworks",
    46→}
    47→
    48→# Shorthand -> CivitAI base model filter values
    49→_BASE_MODEL_MAP = {
    50→    "sd15": "SD 1.5",
    51→    "sd1.5": "SD 1.5",
    52→    "sdxl": "SDXL 1.0",
    53→    "sdxl_turbo": "SDXL Turbo",
    54→    "flux": "Flux.1 D",
    55→    "flux_dev": "Flux.1 D",
    56→    "flux_schnell": "Flux.1 S",
    57→    "sd3": "SD 3",
    58→    "sd3.5": "SD 3.5",
    59→    "pony": "Pony",
    60→    "cascade": "Stable Cascade",
    61→}
    62→
    63→_SORT_MAP = {
    64→    "most_downloaded": "Most Downloaded",
    65→    "highest_rated": "Highest Rated",
    66→    "newest": "Newest",
    67→}
    68→
    69→_PERIOD_MAP = {
    70→    "day": "Day",
    71→    "week": "Week",
    72→    "month": "Month",
    73→    "year": "Year",
    74→    "all_time": "AllTime",
    75→}
    76→
    77→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    78→# Tool schemas
    79→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    80→
    81→TOOLS: list[dict] = [
    82→    {
    83→        "name": "search_civitai",
    84→        "description": (
    85→            "Search CivitAI for models, LoRAs, ControlNets, and embeddings. "
    86→            "Returns community ratings, download counts, and compatibility info. "
    87→            "CivitAI is the largest community hub — use this to discover what's "
    88→            "popular and trending in the Stable Diffusion ecosystem."
    89→        ),
    90→        "input_schema": {
    91→            "type": "object",
    92→            "properties": {
    93→                "query": {
    94→                    "type": "string",
    95→                    "description": "Search term — model name, style, or keyword.",
    96→                },
    97→                "model_type": {
    98→                    "type": "string",
    99→                    "enum": ["checkpoint", "lora", "controlnet", "embedding", "vae", "upscaler"],
   100→                    "description": "Filter by model type.",
   101→                },
   102→                "base_model": {
   103→                    "type": "string",
   104→                    "description": (
   105→                        "Filter by base model: 'sd15', 'sdxl', 'flux', 'sd3', 'pony'."
   106→                    ),
   107→                },
   108→                "sort": {
   109→                    "type": "string",
   110→                    "enum": ["most_downloaded", "highest_rated", "newest"],
   111→                    "description": "Sort order. Default: 'most_downloaded'.",
   112→                },
   113→                "period": {
   114→                    "type": "string",
   115→                    "enum": ["day", "week", "month", "year", "all_time"],
   116→                    "description": "Time period for sorting. Default: 'all_time'.",
   117→                },
   118→                "nsfw": {
   119→                    "type": "boolean",
   120→                    "description": "Include NSFW results. Default: false.",
   121→                },
   122→                "max_results": {
   123→                    "type": "integer",
   124→                    "description": "Max results (1-20). Default: 10.",
   125→                },
   126→            },
   127→            "required": ["query"],
   128→        },
   129→    },
   130→    {
   131→        "name": "get_civitai_model",
   132→        "description": (
   133→            "Get detailed info for a specific CivitAI model by ID. Returns "
   134→            "all versions, files, example images, description, and stats. "
   135→            "Use after search_civitai to get full details before recommending."
   136→        ),
   137→        "input_schema": {
   138→            "type": "object",
   139→            "properties": {
   140→                "model_id": {
   141→                    "type": "integer",
   142→                    "description": "CivitAI model ID (from search results).",
   143→                },
   144→            },
   145→            "required": ["model_id"],
   146→        },
   147→    },
   148→    {
   149→        "name": "get_trending_models",
   150→        "description": (
   151→            "Get trending models on CivitAI this week. Quick way to discover "
   152→            "what's popular right now. Useful for proactive recommendations: "
   153→            "'A new LoRA is trending and compatible with your workflow.'"
   154→        ),
   155→        "input_schema": {
   156→            "type": "object",
   157→            "properties": {
   158→                "model_type": {
   159→                    "type": "string",
   160→                    "enum": ["checkpoint", "lora", "controlnet", "embedding", "vae", "upscaler"],
   161→                    "description": "Filter by type. Default: all types.",
   162→                },
   163→                "base_model": {
   164→                    "type": "string",
   165→                    "description": (
   166→                        "Filter by base: 'sd15', 'sdxl', 'flux', 'sd3', 'pony'."
   167→                    ),
   168→                },
   169→                "period": {
   170→                    "type": "string",
   171→                    "enum": ["day", "week", "month"],
   172→                    "description": "Trending period. Default: 'week'.",
   173→                },
   174→                "max_results": {
   175→                    "type": "integer",
   176→                    "description": "Max results (1-20). Default: 10.",
   177→                },
   178→            },
   179→            "required": [],
   180→        },
   181→    },
   182→]
   183→
   184→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   185→# Helpers
   186→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   187→
   188→def _strip_html(text: str) -> str:
   189→    """Remove HTML tags from CivitAI descriptions."""
   190→    if not text:
   191→        return ""
   192→    return re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", text).strip()
   193→
   194→
   195→def _build_headers() -> dict:
   196→    """Build request headers with optional auth."""
   197→    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
   198→    if CIVITAI_API_KEY:
   199→        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {CIVITAI_API_KEY}"
   200→    return headers
   201→
   202→
   203→def _check_installed(model_type: str, files: list[dict]) -> bool:
   204→    """Check if any file from a CivitAI model version is installed locally."""
   205→    if not MODELS_DIR.exists():
   206→        return False
   207→    subdir = _TYPE_TO_SUBDIR.get(model_type, "")
   208→    if subdir:
   209→        target_dir = MODELS_DIR / subdir
   210→        if target_dir.exists():
   211→            for f in files:
   212→                name = f.get("name", "")
   213→                if name and (target_dir / name).exists():
   214→                    return True
   215→    # Fallback: search all model subdirectories
   216→    for d in sorted(MODELS_DIR.iterdir()):
   217→        if d.is_dir():
   218→            for f in files:
   219→                name = f.get("name", "")
   220→                if name and (d / name).exists():
   221→                    return True
   222→    return False
   223→
   224→
   225→def _parse_model(model: dict) -> dict:
   226→    """Extract key fields from a CivitAI model response."""
   227→    stats = model.get("stats", {})
   228→    creator = model.get("creator", {})
   229→    versions = model.get("modelVersions", [])
   230→    model_type = model.get("type", "")
   231→
   232→    latest = versions[0] if versions else {}
   233→    latest_files = latest.get("files", [])
   234→
   235→    return {
   236→        "id": model.get("id"),
   237→        "name": model.get("name", ""),
   238→        "type": model_type,
   239→        "creator": creator.get("username", ""),
   240→        "rating": round(stats.get("rating", 0), 2),
   241→        "downloads": stats.get("downloadCount", 0),
   242→        "favorites": stats.get("favoriteCount", 0),
   243→        "tags": sorted(model.get("tags", []))[:8],
   244→        "base_model": latest.get("baseModel", ""),
   245→        "latest_version": latest.get("name", ""),
   246→        "nsfw": model.get("nsfw", False),
   247→        "url": f"https://civitai.com/models/{model.get('id', '')}",
   248→        "installed": _check_installed(model_type, latest_files),
   249→    }
   250→
   251→
   252→def _parse_model_detail(model: dict) -> dict:
   253→    """Parse full model detail including versions and files."""
   254→    stats = model.get("stats", {})
   255→    creator = model.get("creator", {})
   256→    model_type = model.get("type", "")
   257→
   258→    versions = []
   259→    for v in model.get("modelVersions", [])[:5]:
   260→        files = []
   261→        for f in v.get("files", []):
   262→            files.append({
   263→                "name": f.get("name", ""),
   264→                "size_kb": round(f.get("sizeKB", 0)),
   265→                "format": f.get("metadata", {}).get("format", ""),
   266→            })
   267→        images = [
   268→            img.get("url", "")
   269→            for img in v.get("images", [])[:3]
   270→            if img.get("url")
   271→        ]
   272→        versions.append({
   273→            "id": v.get("id"),
   274→            "name": v.get("name", ""),
   275→            "base_model": v.get("baseModel", ""),
   276→            "created_at": v.get("createdAt", "")[:10],
   277→            "download_url": v.get("downloadUrl", ""),
   278→            "files": files,
   279→            "example_images": images,
   280→            "installed": _check_installed(model_type, v.get("files", [])),
   281→        })
   282→
   283→    return {
   284→        "id": model.get("id"),
   285→        "name": model.get("name", ""),
   286→        "type": model_type,
   287→        "creator": creator.get("username", ""),
   288→        "description": _strip_html(model.get("description", ""))[:500],
   289→        "tags": sorted(model.get("tags", []))[:10],
   290→        "nsfw": model.get("nsfw", False),
   291→        "stats": {
   292→            "downloads": stats.get("downloadCount", 0),
   293→            "favorites": stats.get("favoriteCount", 0),
   294→            "rating": round(stats.get("rating", 0), 2),
   295→            "rating_count": stats.get("ratingCount", 0),
   296→        },
   297→        "versions": versions,
   298→        "url": f"https://civitai.com/models/{model.get('id', '')}",
   299→    }
   300→
   301→
   302→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   303→# Handlers
   304→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   305→
   306→def _handle_search_civitai(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   307→    query = tool_input["query"]
   308→    model_type = tool_input.get("model_type")
   309→    base_model = tool_input.get("base_model")
   310→    sort = tool_input.get("sort", "most_downloaded")
   311→    period = tool_input.get("period", "all_time")
   312→    nsfw = tool_input.get("nsfw", False)
   313→    max_results = min(tool_input.get("max_results", 10), 20)
   314→
   315→    params: dict = {
   316→        "query": query,
   317→        "limit": max_results,
   318→        "sort": _SORT_MAP.get(sort, "Most Downloaded"),
   319→        "period": _PERIOD_MAP.get(period, "AllTime"),
   320→        "nsfw": str(nsfw).lower(),
   321→    }
   322→
   323→    if model_type:
   324→        civitai_type = _TYPE_MAP.get(model_type.lower())
   325→        if civitai_type:
   326→            params["types"] = civitai_type
   327→
   328→    if base_model:
   329→        bm = _BASE_MODEL_MAP.get(base_model.lower(), base_model)
   330→        params["baseModels"] = bm
   331→
   332→    if not CIVITAI_LIMITER().acquire(timeout=5.0):
   333→        return to_json({"error": "Rate limited — too many CivitAI requests. Try again shortly."})
   334→
   335→    try:
   336→        with httpx.Client() as client:
   337→            resp = client.get(
   338→                f"{CIVITAI_API}/models",
   339→                params=params,
   340→                headers=_build_headers(),
   341→                timeout=20.0,
   342→            )
   343→            resp.raise_for_status()
   344→            data = resp.json()
   345→    except httpx.ConnectError:
   346→        return to_json({"error": "Could not reach CivitAI API. Check internet connection."})
   347→    except httpx.HTTPStatusError as e:
   348→        return to_json({"error": f"CivitAI API returned {e.response.status_code}."})
   349→    except Exception as e:
   350→        return to_json({"error": f"CivitAI search failed: {e}"})
   351→
   352→    items = data.get("items", [])
   353→    results = [_parse_model(m) for m in items]
   354→
   355→    return to_json({
   356→        "source": "civitai",
   357→        "query": query,
   358→        "type_filter": model_type,
   359→        "base_model_filter": base_model,
   360→        "sort": sort,
   361→        "period": period,
   362→        "results": results,
   363→        "showing": len(results),
   364→        "total_available": data.get("metadata", {}).get("totalItems", len(results)),
   365→    })
   366→
   367→
   368→def _handle_get_civitai_model(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   369→    model_id = tool_input["model_id"]
   370→
   371→    if not CIVITAI_LIMITER().acquire(timeout=5.0):
   372→        return to_json({"error": "Rate limited — too many CivitAI requests. Try again shortly."})
   373→
   374→    try:
   375→        with httpx.Client() as client:
   376→            resp = client.get(
   377→                f"{CIVITAI_API}/models/{model_id}",
   378→                headers=_build_headers(),
   379→                timeout=20.0,
   380→            )
   381→            resp.raise_for_status()
   382→            data = resp.json()
   383→    except httpx.ConnectError:
   384→        return to_json({"error": "Could not reach CivitAI API. Check internet connection."})
   385→    except httpx.HTTPStatusError as e:
   386→        if e.response.status_code == 404:
   387→            return to_json({"error": f"Model {model_id} not found on CivitAI."})
   388→        return to_json({"error": f"CivitAI API returned {e.response.status_code}."})
   389→    except Exception as e:
   390→        return to_json({"error": f"CivitAI request failed: {e}"})
   391→
   392→    return to_json(_parse_model_detail(data))
   393→
   394→
   395→def _handle_get_trending_models(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   396→    model_type = tool_input.get("model_type")
   397→    base_model = tool_input.get("base_model")
   398→    period = tool_input.get("period", "week")
   399→    max_results = min(tool_input.get("max_results", 10), 20)
   400→
   401→    params: dict = {
   402→        "limit": max_results,
   403→        "sort": "Most Downloaded",
   404→        "period": _PERIOD_MAP.get(period, "Week"),
   405→        "nsfw": "false",
   406→    }
   407→
   408→    if model_type:
   409→        civitai_type = _TYPE_MAP.get(model_type.lower())
   410→        if civitai_type:
   411→            params["types"] = civitai_type
   412→
   413→    if base_model:
   414→        bm = _BASE_MODEL_MAP.get(base_model.lower(), base_model)
   415→        params["baseModels"] = bm
   416→
   417→    if not CIVITAI_LIMITER().acquire(timeout=5.0):
   418→        return to_json({"error": "Rate limited — too many CivitAI requests. Try again shortly."})
   419→
   420→    try:
   421→        with httpx.Client() as client:
   422→            resp = client.get(
   423→                f"{CIVITAI_API}/models",
   424→                params=params,
   425→                headers=_build_headers(),
   426→                timeout=20.0,
   427→            )
   428→            resp.raise_for_status()
   429→            data = resp.json()
   430→    except httpx.ConnectError:
   431→        return to_json({"error": "Could not reach CivitAI API. Check internet connection."})
   432→    except httpx.HTTPStatusError as e:
   433→        return to_json({"error": f"CivitAI API returned {e.response.status_code}."})
   434→    except Exception as e:
   435→        return to_json({"error": f"CivitAI trending request failed: {e}"})
   436→
   437→    items = data.get("items", [])
   438→    results = [_parse_model(m) for m in items]
   439→
   440→    return to_json({
   441→        "source": "civitai_trending",
   442→        "period": period,
   443→        "type_filter": model_type,
   444→        "base_model_filter": base_model,
   445→        "results": results,
   446→        "showing": len(results),
   447→    })
   448→
   449→
   450→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   451→# Dispatch
   452→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   453→
   454→def handle(name: str, tool_input: dict) -> str:
   455→    """Execute a CivitAI tool call."""
   456→    try:
   457→        if name == "search_civitai":
   458→            return _handle_search_civitai(tool_input)
   459→        elif name == "get_civitai_model":
   460→            return _handle_get_civitai_model(tool_input)
   461→        elif name == "get_trending_models":

1→"""Model compatibility matrix — prevents mismatched model combos.
     2→
     3→Knowledge base of SD 1.5 / SDXL / Flux / SD3 model families. Cross-references
     4→checkpoint, VAE, ControlNet, and LoRA compatibility based on filename patterns
     5→and base model families. Prevents the "swapped a model and now it crashes" scenario.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→import logging
     9→import re
    10→from pathlib import Path
    11→
    12→from ._util import to_json
    13→
    14→log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    15→
    16→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    17→# Compatibility knowledge base
    18→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    19→
    20→MODEL_FAMILIES = {
    21→    "sd15": {
    22→        "label": "Stable Diffusion 1.5",
    23→        "resolution": "512x512",
    24→        "checkpoint_patterns": [
    25→            r"(?i)sd[-_]?v?1[-_.]?5", r"(?i)sd[-_]?1[-_.]?5",
    26→            r"(?i)realisticVision", r"(?i)dreamshaper",
    27→            r"(?i)deliberate", r"(?i)anything[-_]?v[345]",
    28→            r"(?i)revAnimated", r"(?i)majicmix",
    29→        ],
    30→        "vae_patterns": [
    31→            r"(?i)vae[-_]ft[-_]mse", r"(?i)sd[-_]?v?1.*vae",
    32→            r"(?i)kl[-_]f8[-_]anime",
    33→        ],
    34→        "controlnet_patterns": [
    35→            r"(?i)control_v11p_sd15", r"(?i)control_sd15",
    36→            r"(?i)t2iadapter_.*sd15",
    37→        ],
    38→        "lora_compatible": True,
    39→        "incompatible_families": ["sdxl", "flux", "sd3"],
    40→    },
    41→    "sdxl": {
    42→        "label": "Stable Diffusion XL",
    43→        "resolution": "1024x1024",
    44→        "checkpoint_patterns": [
    45→            r"(?i)sdxl", r"(?i)sd[-_]?xl",
    46→            r"(?i)juggernaut[-_]?xl", r"(?i)dreamshaperXL",
    47→            r"(?i)realvis[-_]?xl", r"(?i)pony",
    48→            r"(?i)colossus", r"(?i)proteus",
    49→        ],
    50→        "vae_patterns": [
    51→            r"(?i)sdxl.*vae", r"(?i)sdxl[-_]vae",
    52→        ],
    53→        "controlnet_patterns": [
    54→            r"(?i)sdxl[-_]controlnet", r"(?i)control.*sdxl",
    55→            r"(?i)diffusers_xl_.*controlnet",
    56→        ],
    57→        "lora_compatible": True,
    58→        "incompatible_families": ["sd15", "flux", "sd3"],
    59→    },
    60→    "flux": {
    61→        "label": "Flux",
    62→        "resolution": "1024x1024",
    63→        "checkpoint_patterns": [
    64→            r"(?i)flux[-_.]?1", r"(?i)flux[-_]dev",
    65→            r"(?i)flux[-_]schnell", r"(?i)flux[-_]fp",
    66→        ],
    67→        "vae_patterns": [
    68→            r"(?i)ae[-_]?t5", r"(?i)flux.*vae",
    69→        ],
    70→        "controlnet_patterns": [
    71→            r"(?i)flux.*controlnet", r"(?i)controlnet.*flux",
    72→            r"(?i)union[-_]pro.*flux",
    73→        ],
    74→        "lora_compatible": True,
    75→        "incompatible_families": ["sd15", "sdxl", "sd3"],
    76→    },
    77→    "sd3": {
    78→        "label": "Stable Diffusion 3",
    79→        "resolution": "1024x1024",
    80→        "checkpoint_patterns": [
    81→            r"(?i)sd[-_]?3", r"(?i)stable[-_]diffusion[-_]?3",
    82→        ],
    83→        "vae_patterns": [
    84→            r"(?i)sd3.*vae",
    85→        ],
    86→        "controlnet_patterns": [
    87→            r"(?i)sd3.*controlnet",
    88→        ],
    89→        "lora_compatible": True,
    90→        "incompatible_families": ["sd15", "sdxl", "flux"],
    91→    },
    92→}
    93→
    94→
    95→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    96→# Tool schemas
    97→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    98→
    99→TOOLS: list[dict] = [
   100→    {
   101→        "name": "check_model_compatibility",
   102→        "description": (
   103→            "Check if models are compatible with each other and the current workflow. "
   104→            "Cross-references checkpoint, VAE, ControlNet, and LoRA by base model "
   105→            "family (SD 1.5 / SDXL / Flux / SD3). Prevents mismatched model combos "
   106→            "that cause silent failures or crashes."
   107→        ),
   108→        "input_schema": {
   109→            "type": "object",
   110→            "properties": {
   111→                "models": {
   112→                    "type": "array",
   113→                    "items": {"type": "string"},
   114→                    "description": (
   115→                        "List of model filenames to check compatibility between. "
   116→                        "Example: ['sdxl_base.safetensors', 'control_v11p_sd15_depth.pth']"
   117→                    ),
   118→                },
   119→                "workflow_path": {
   120→                    "type": "string",
   121→                    "description": (
   122→                        "Optional path to workflow JSON. If provided, extracts model "
   123→                        "references from the workflow and checks compatibility."
   124→                    ),
   125→                },
   126→            },
   127→            "required": [],
   128→        },
   129→    },
   130→    {
   131→        "name": "identify_model_family",
   132→        "description": (
   133→            "Identify which base model family a model file belongs to. "
   134→            "Returns: sd15, sdxl, flux, sd3, or unknown. Use to verify "
   135→            "compatibility before swapping models."
   136→        ),
   137→        "input_schema": {
   138→            "type": "object",
   139→            "properties": {
   140→                "model_name": {
   141→                    "type": "string",
   142→                    "description": "Model filename (e.g., 'realisticVisionV60B1.safetensors').",
   143→                },
   144→            },
   145→            "required": ["model_name"],
   146→        },
   147→    },
   148→]
   149→
   150→
   151→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   152→# Detection logic
   153→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   154→
   155→def _identify_family(model_name: str) -> str:
   156→    """Identify model family from filename using pattern matching."""
   157→    for family_id, family in sorted(MODEL_FAMILIES.items()):
   158→        for pattern_list in [
   159→            family["checkpoint_patterns"],
   160→            family["vae_patterns"],
   161→            family["controlnet_patterns"],
   162→        ]:
   163→            for pattern in pattern_list:
   164→                if re.search(pattern, model_name):
   165→                    return family_id
   166→    return "unknown"
   167→
   168→
   169→def _extract_models_from_workflow(workflow: dict) -> list[str]:
   170→    """Extract model filenames referenced in a workflow."""
   171→    models = []
   172→    model_input_names = {
   173→        "ckpt_name", "vae_name", "lora_name", "control_net_name",
   174→        "model_name", "clip_name", "unet_name",
   175→    }
   176→    for node in workflow.values():
   177→        if not isinstance(node, dict):
   178→            continue
   179→        inputs = node.get("inputs", {})
   180→        for key, value in inputs.items():
   181→            if key in model_input_names and isinstance(value, str):
   182→                models.append(value)
   183→    return sorted(set(models))
   184→
   185→
   186→def _check_compatibility(models: list[str]) -> dict:
   187→    """Check compatibility between a set of models."""
   188→    identified = {}
   189→    for m in models:
   190→        identified[m] = _identify_family(m)
   191→
   192→    # Find unique families (excluding unknown)
   193→    families = set(f for f in identified.values() if f != "unknown")
   194→
   195→    if len(families) <= 1:
   196→        family = families.pop() if families else "unknown"
   197→        return {
   198→            "compatible": True,
   199→            "family": family,
   200→            "family_label": MODEL_FAMILIES.get(family, {}).get("label", "Unknown"),
   201→            "resolution": MODEL_FAMILIES.get(family, {}).get("resolution", "unknown"),
   202→            "models": identified,
   203→            "message": f"All models belong to {MODEL_FAMILIES.get(family, {}).get('label', 'unknown')} family.",
   204→        }
   205→
   206→    # Multiple families detected — incompatible
   207→    conflicts = []
   208→    family_list = sorted(families)
   209→    for i, f1 in enumerate(family_list):
   210→        for f2 in family_list[i + 1:]:
   211→            # He2025: sorted iteration for deterministic model lists
   212→            f1_models = [m for m, f in sorted(identified.items()) if f == f1]
   213→            f2_models = [m for m, f in sorted(identified.items()) if f == f2]
   214→            conflicts.append({
   215→                "family_a": f1,
   216→                "family_b": f2,
   217→                "models_a": f1_models,
   218→                "models_b": f2_models,
   219→                "reason": f"{MODEL_FAMILIES[f1]['label']} models are incompatible with {MODEL_FAMILIES[f2]['label']}",
   220→            })
   221→
   222→    return {
   223→        "compatible": False,
   224→        "families_detected": family_list,
   225→        "models": identified,
   226→        "conflicts": conflicts,
   227→        "message": f"Incompatible model families detected: {', '.join(MODEL_FAMILIES[f]['label'] for f in family_list)}",
   228→        "suggestion": f"Use models from the same family. Detected: {', '.join(family_list)}",
   229→    }
   230→
   231→
   232→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   233→# Handlers
   234→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   235→
   236→def _handle_check_compatibility(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   237→    models = tool_input.get("models", [])
   238→    workflow_path = tool_input.get("workflow_path")
   239→
   240→    if workflow_path:
   241→        import json
   242→        path = Path(workflow_path)
   243→        if not path.exists():
   244→            return to_json({"error": f"File not found: {workflow_path}"})
   245→        try:
   246→            data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   247→        except Exception as e:
   248→            return to_json({"error": f"Failed to parse workflow: {e}"})
   249→
   250→        # Extract API-format nodes
   251→        if "nodes" in data and isinstance(data["nodes"], list):
   252→            prompt_data = data.get("extra", {}).get("prompt")
   253→            if prompt_data:
   254→                wf_models = _extract_models_from_workflow(prompt_data)
   255→            else:
   256→                wf_models = []
   257→        else:
   258→            wf_models = _extract_models_from_workflow(data)
   259→
   260→        models = sorted(set(models + wf_models))
   261→
   262→    if not models:
   263→        # Try loaded workflow
   264→        from .workflow_patch import get_current_workflow
   265→        wf = get_current_workflow()
   266→        if wf:
   267→            models = _extract_models_from_workflow(wf)
   268→
   269→    if not models:
   270→        return to_json({
   271→            "error": "No models to check. Provide model names, a workflow path, or load a workflow.",
   272→        })
   273→
   274→    result = _check_compatibility(models)
   275→    return to_json(result)
   276→
   277→
   278→def _handle_identify_family(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   279→    model_name = tool_input["model_name"]
   280→    family = _identify_family(model_name)
   281→    info = MODEL_FAMILIES.get(family, {})
   282→
   283→    return to_json({
   284→        "model": model_name,
   285→        "family": family,
   286→        "label": info.get("label", "Unknown"),
   287→        "resolution": info.get("resolution", "unknown"),
   288→        "lora_compatible": info.get("lora_compatible", False),
   289→        "incompatible_with": [
   290→            MODEL_FAMILIES[f]["label"]
   291→            for f in info.get("incompatible_families", [])
   292→        ],
   293→    })
   294→
   295→
   296→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   297→# Dispatch
   298→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   299→
   300→def handle(name: str, tool_input: dict) -> str:
   301→    """Execute a model compatibility tool call."""
   302→    try:
   303→        if name == "check_model_compatibility":
   304→            return _handle_check_compatibility(tool_input)
   305→        elif name == "identify_model_family":
   306→            return _handle_identify_family(tool_input)
   307→        else:
   308→            return to_json({"error": f"Unknown tool: {name}"})
   309→    except Exception as e:
   310→        return to_json({"error": str(e)})
   311→

1→"""Filesystem inspection tools.
     2→
     3→Reads the local ComfyUI installation to discover installed
     4→custom nodes, models, and their on-disk details — without
     5→needing ComfyUI to be running.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→from pathlib import Path
     9→
    10→from ..config import CUSTOM_NODES_DIR, MODELS_DIR
    11→from ._util import to_json
    12→
    13→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    14→# Tool schemas
    15→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16→
    17→TOOLS: list[dict] = [
    18→    {
    19→        "name": "list_custom_nodes",
    20→        "description": (
    21→            "List all installed ComfyUI custom node packs by scanning "
    22→            "the Custom_Nodes directory. Returns pack names, whether they "
    23→            "have a README or requirements.txt, and node count if detectable."
    24→        ),
    25→        "input_schema": {
    26→            "type": "object",
    27→            "properties": {
    28→                "name_filter": {
    29→                    "type": "string",
    30→                    "description": "Optional substring filter on pack name (case-insensitive).",
    31→                },
    32→            },
    33→            "required": [],
    34→        },
    35→    },
    36→    {
    37→        "name": "list_models",
    38→        "description": (
    39→            "List model files in a specific model subdirectory "
    40→            "(e.g. 'checkpoints', 'loras', 'controlnet', 'vae'). "
    41→            "Use format='names_only' for just filenames, "
    42→            "'summary' (default) for name+size, 'full' for all details."
    43→        ),
    44→        "input_schema": {
    45→            "type": "object",
    46→            "properties": {
    47→                "model_type": {
    48→                    "type": "string",
    49→                    "description": (
    50→                        "Subdirectory under models/ to scan. "
    51→                        "Common: checkpoints, loras, vae, controlnet, "
    52→                        "clip, upscale_models, embeddings, unet, diffusion_models."
    53→                    ),
    54→                },
    55→                "format": {
    56→                    "type": "string",
    57→                    "enum": ["names_only", "summary", "full"],
    58→                    "description": (
    59→                        "'names_only': just filenames. "
    60→                        "'summary': name + human-readable size (default). "
    61→                        "'full': name + size + size_bytes."
    62→                    ),
    63→                },
    64→            },
    65→            "required": ["model_type"],
    66→        },
    67→    },
    68→    {
    69→        "name": "get_models_summary",
    70→        "description": (
    71→            "Get a summary of all model directories: "
    72→            "which types exist and how many files each contains."
    73→        ),
    74→        "input_schema": {
    75→            "type": "object",
    76→            "properties": {},
    77→            "required": [],
    78→        },
    79→    },
    80→    {
    81→        "name": "read_node_source",
    82→        "description": (
    83→            "Read the source code of a custom node pack's entry point "
    84→            "(__init__.py) to understand what nodes it registers. "
    85→            "Useful for discovering NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS."
    86→        ),
    87→        "input_schema": {
    88→            "type": "object",
    89→            "properties": {
    90→                "node_pack": {
    91→                    "type": "string",
    92→                    "description": "Name of the custom node pack directory.",
    93→                },
    94→                "max_lines": {
    95→                    "type": "integer",
    96→                    "description": "Maximum lines to read (default 200).",
    97→                },
    98→            },
    99→            "required": ["node_pack"],
   100→        },
   101→    },
   102→]
   103→
   104→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   105→# Helpers
   106→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   107→
   108→_MODEL_EXTENSIONS = {".safetensors", ".ckpt", ".pt", ".pth", ".bin", ".gguf", ".onnx"}
   109→
   110→
   111→def _human_size(nbytes: int) -> str:
   112→    """Format bytes as human-readable size."""
   113→    for unit in ("B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"):
   114→        if abs(nbytes) < 1024:
   115→            return f"{nbytes:.1f} {unit}"
   116→        nbytes /= 1024
   117→    return f"{nbytes:.1f} PB"
   118→
   119→
   120→def _is_node_pack(path: Path) -> bool:
   121→    """Check if a directory looks like a custom node pack."""
   122→    if not path.is_dir():
   123→        return False
   124→    name = path.name
   125→    # Skip __pycache__, hidden dirs, temp dirs
   126→    if name.startswith((".", "__", "tmp")):
   127→        return False
   128→    # Must have Python files
   129→    return any(path.glob("*.py"))
   130→
   131→
   132→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   133→# Handlers
   134→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   135→
   136→def _handle_list_custom_nodes(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   137→    name_filter = (tool_input.get("name_filter") or "").lower()
   138→
   139→    if not CUSTOM_NODES_DIR.exists():
   140→        return to_json({
   141→            "error": f"Custom nodes directory not found: {CUSTOM_NODES_DIR}",
   142→        })
   143→
   144→    packs = []
   145→    for item in sorted(CUSTOM_NODES_DIR.iterdir()):
   146→        if not _is_node_pack(item):
   147→            continue
   148→        if name_filter and name_filter not in item.name.lower():
   149→            continue
   150→
   151→        info = {"name": item.name}
   152→
   153→        # Check for README
   154→        for readme_name in ("README.md", "readme.md", "README.rst"):
   155→            if (item / readme_name).exists():
   156→                info["has_readme"] = True
   157→                break
   158→
   159→        # Check for requirements
   160→        info["has_requirements"] = (item / "requirements.txt").exists()
   161→
   162→        # Try to count registered nodes from __init__.py
   163→        init_file = item / "__init__.py"
   164→        if init_file.exists():
   165→            try:
   166→                content = init_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
   167→                if "NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS" in content:
   168→                    info["registers_nodes"] = True
   169→            except Exception:
   170→                pass
   171→
   172→        packs.append(info)
   173→
   174→    return to_json({
   175→        "directory": str(CUSTOM_NODES_DIR),
   176→        "count": len(packs),
   177→        "packs": packs,
   178→    })
   179→
   180→
   181→def _handle_list_models(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   182→    model_type = tool_input["model_type"]
   183→    fmt = tool_input.get("format", "summary")
   184→    model_dir = MODELS_DIR / model_type
   185→
   186→    if not model_dir.exists():
   187→        # List available types
   188→        available = [d.name for d in MODELS_DIR.iterdir() if d.is_dir()]
   189→        return to_json({
   190→            "error": f"Model directory '{model_type}' not found.",
   191→            "available_types": sorted(available),
   192→        })
   193→
   194→    # Collect model paths
   195→    model_files = sorted(
   196→        f for f in model_dir.rglob("*")
   197→        if f.is_file() and f.suffix.lower() in _MODEL_EXTENSIONS
   198→    )
   199→
   200→    base = {
   201→        "model_type": model_type,
   202→        "directory": str(model_dir),
   203→        "count": len(model_files),
   204→    }
   205→
   206→    if fmt == "names_only":
   207→        base["models"] = [str(f.relative_to(model_dir)) for f in model_files]
   208→        return to_json(base)
   209→
   210→    if fmt == "full":
   211→        base["models"] = [
   212→            {
   213→                "name": str(f.relative_to(model_dir)),
   214→                "size": _human_size(f.stat().st_size),
   215→                "size_bytes": f.stat().st_size,
   216→            }
   217→            for f in model_files
   218→        ]
   219→        return to_json(base)
   220→
   221→    # Default: summary (name + human-readable size)
   222→    base["models"] = [
   223→        {"name": str(f.relative_to(model_dir)), "size": _human_size(f.stat().st_size)}
   224→        for f in model_files
   225→    ]
   226→    return to_json(base)
   227→
   228→
   229→def _handle_get_models_summary() -> str:
   230→    if not MODELS_DIR.exists():
   231→        return to_json({"error": f"Models directory not found: {MODELS_DIR}"})
   232→
   233→    summary = {}
   234→    for d in sorted(MODELS_DIR.iterdir()):
   235→        if not d.is_dir():
   236→            continue
   237→        count = sum(
   238→            1 for f in d.rglob("*")
   239→            if f.is_file() and f.suffix.lower() in _MODEL_EXTENSIONS
   240→        )
   241→        if count > 0:
   242→            summary[d.name] = count
   243→
   244→    return to_json({
   245→        "directory": str(MODELS_DIR),
   246→        "types": summary,
   247→        "total_types": len(summary),
   248→    })
   249→
   250→
   251→def _handle_read_node_source(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   252→    node_pack = tool_input["node_pack"]
   253→    max_lines = tool_input.get("max_lines", 200)
   254→
   255→    pack_dir = CUSTOM_NODES_DIR / node_pack
   256→    # Prevent path traversal (e.g., "../../etc/passwd")
   257→    try:
   258→        resolved = pack_dir.resolve()
   259→        if not str(resolved).startswith(str(CUSTOM_NODES_DIR.resolve())):
   260→            return to_json({"error": "Access denied: path escapes Custom_Nodes directory."})
   261→    except (OSError, ValueError):
   262→        return to_json({"error": f"Invalid node pack name: {node_pack}"})
   263→
   264→    if not pack_dir.exists():
   265→        # Suggest similar names
   266→        # He2025: sort for deterministic suggestion order
   267→        available = sorted([
   268→            d.name for d in CUSTOM_NODES_DIR.iterdir()
   269→            if _is_node_pack(d) and node_pack.lower() in d.name.lower()
   270→        ])
   271→        return to_json({
   272→            "error": f"Node pack '{node_pack}' not found.",
   273→            "similar": available[:10],
   274→        })
   275→
   276→    init_file = pack_dir / "__init__.py"
   277→    if not init_file.exists():
   278→        # Try to find main Python files
   279→        py_files = sorted(pack_dir.glob("*.py"))
   280→        return to_json({
   281→            "error": f"No __init__.py in '{node_pack}'.",
   282→            "python_files": [f.name for f in py_files[:20]],
   283→        })
   284→
   285→    try:
   286→        lines = init_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
   287→        truncated = len(lines) > max_lines
   288→        source = "\n".join(lines[:max_lines])
   289→    except Exception as e:
   290→        return to_json({"error": f"Could not read file: {e}"})
   291→
   292→    return to_json({
   293→        "pack": node_pack,
   294→        "file": str(init_file),
   295→        "total_lines": len(lines),
   296→        "truncated": truncated,
   297→        "source": source,
   298→    })
   299→
   300→
   301→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   302→# Dispatch
   303→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   304→
   305→def handle(name: str, tool_input: dict) -> str:
   306→    """Execute a comfy_inspect tool call."""
   307→    try:
   308→        if name == "list_custom_nodes":
   309→            return _handle_list_custom_nodes(tool_input)
   310→        elif name == "list_models":
   311→            return _handle_list_models(tool_input)
   312→        elif name == "get_models_summary":
   313→            return _handle_get_models_summary()
   314→        elif name == "read_node_source":
   315→            return _handle_read_node_source(tool_input)
   316→        else:
   317→            return to_json({"error": f"Unknown tool: {name}"})
   318→    except Exception as e:
   319→        return to_json({"error": str(e)})
   320→

## DISCOVER Layer Tools — Complete Inventory

### **Layer Overview**
The DISCOVER layer consists of 4 modules providing 8 tools total:
- **comfy_discover.py** — 5 tools (registry search, model search, missing nodes, install instructions, freshness check)
- **civitai_api.py** — 3 tools (search, model details, trending)
- **model_compat.py** — 2 tools (compatibility checking, family identification)
- **comfy_inspect.py** — 4 tools (list customs nodes, list models, model summary, read source)

---

## **TOOL DETAIL TABLE**

| Tool Name | Module | Input Params | Data Sources | Output | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **search_custom_nodes** | comfy_discover | `query` (str, required), `by` (enum: "name"\|"node_type", default "name"), `max_results` (int, default 10) | ComfyUI Manager: `custom-node-list.json` + `extension-node-map.json`; local filesystem via `_is_pack_installed()` | `{query, results: [{title, author, description, url, install_type, installed}], total_matches, showing}` or fuzzy match variants | Two search modes: by pack name/description, or by specific node class_type. Scores matches and boosts exact title hits. |
| **search_models** | comfy_discover | `query` (str, required), `model_type` (str, optional), `source` (enum: "registry"\|"huggingface", default "registry"), `max_results` (int, default 10) | **Registry mode**: ComfyUI Manager `model-list.json`. **HuggingFace mode**: HuggingFace Hub API (`/api/models`). Rate limited by `HUGGINGFACE_LIMITER`. | `{source, query, type_filter, results: [{name, type, base, description, filename, url, size, save_path, installed}], total_matches, showing}` | Two sources: fast local registry (500+ curated models) or broader HuggingFace API search. Cross-references local filesystem to check if installed. |
| **find_missing_nodes** | comfy_discover | `path` (str, optional) — path to workflow JSON | **If path given**: parses workflow JSON (supports API format, UI+API, UI-only). **If not given**: uses current workflow from `workflow_patch.get_current_workflow()`. **Live check**: ComfyUI `/object_info` endpoint. **Registry lookup**: `extension-node-map.json` | `{status: "all_installed"\|"missing_nodes", total_node_types, installed_count, missing_count, missing_nodes: [{node_type, pack_title, pack_url, pack_installed}], packs_to_install: [{title, url, installed, missing_nodes}]}` | Analyzes a workflow JSON (file or loaded), extracts class_types, queries live ComfyUI to check availability, then looks up missing nodes in the registry to suggest which packs to install. |
| **get_install_instructions** | comfy_discover | `query` (str, required), `source` (enum: "registry"\|"civitai"\|"huggingface", default "registry") | **Registry**: `extension-node-map.json` + `custom-node-list.json` + `model-list.json`. **CivitAI/HuggingFace**: delegates to respective tools with instructions. | `{source, type: "node_pack"\|"model", query, pack_title\|model_name, installed, install_commands: [str], message}` | Provides step-by-step install instructions (git clone for node packs, download URLs for models). Returns formatted commands ready to copy-paste. |
| **check_registry_freshness** | comfy_discover | `refresh` (bool, optional) — if true, clears in-memory caches | **File age analysis**: checks mtime of `custom-node-list.json`, `extension-node-map.json`, `model-list.json`. **Model dir stats**: scans `MODELS_DIR` for subdirectories and counts model files. **In-memory cache state**: tracks what's cached. | `{registries: {key: {exists, path, age_seconds, age_human, status: "fresh"\|"stale"\|"very_stale"}}, cache: {custom_nodes_cached, extension_map_cached, node_to_pack_cached, model_list_cached}, models: {exists, types: {subdir: count}, total_files}, manager_installed, recommendations: [str], refreshed}` | Staleness thresholds: 7 days stale, 30 days very_stale. Returns recommendations (e.g., "Update ComfyUI Manager"). Clears caches if `refresh=true`. |

Design the implementation plan for Phase 2: Unified Discovery in the ComfyUI SUPER DUPER Agent at C:\Users\User\comfyui-agent.

## Context
The agent has 62 tools, 459 tests. Phase 1 (MCP-first) is complete. The DISCOVER layer currently has 14 tools across 4 modules. The goal is to merge 3 search tools into 1 unified `discover` tool and add update checking.

## Current DISCOVER Search Tools (to merge)

**1. search_custom_nodes** (comfy_discover.py)
- Input: `{query, by: "name"|"node_type", max_results}`
- Sources: ComfyUI Manager custom-node-list.json + extension-node-map.json
- Returns: scored list of node packs with installed status

**2. search_models** (comfy_discover.py)  
- Input: `{query, model_type, source: "registry"|"huggingface", max_results}`
- Sources: ComfyUI Manager model-list.json OR HuggingFace API
- Returns: model list with installed status

**3. search_civitai** (civitai_api.py)
- Input: `{query, model_type, base_model, sort, period, nsfw, max_results}`
- Sources: CivitAI REST API (rate-limited)
- Returns: model list with downloads/ratings/installed status

## Tools to Keep Unchanged
- get_civitai_model (detail lookup by ID)
- get_trending_models (different intent — "what's hot" not "find X")
- find_missing_nodes, get_install_instructions, check_registry_freshness
- All comfy_inspect tools (UNDERSTAND layer)
- All model_compat tools (compatibility checking)

## Existing Internal Functions (reuse, don't rewrite)
All in comfy_discover.py:
- `_search_by_name(query, max_results)` — searches custom-node-list.json
- `_search_by_node_type(query, max_results)` — searches extension-node-map.json  
- `_search_models_registry(query, model_type, max_results)` — searches model-list.json
- `_search_models_hf(query, model_type, max_results)` — calls HuggingFace API

In civitai_api.py:
- `_handle_search(tool_input)` — calls CivitAI API
- `_parse_model(m)` — normalizes CivitAI response
- `_check_installed(model)` — checks local filesystem

## Design Requirements

1. **Unified `discover` tool** with input schema:
   - `query` (required) — what to search for
   - `category` — "nodes"|"models"|"all" (default "all")
   - `sources` — list of sources to search, or "all" (default "all")
   - `model_type` — optional filter (lora, checkpoint, controlnet, etc.)
   - `base_model` — optional filter (sd15, sdxl, flux, sd3)
   - `sort` — for CivitAI: most_downloaded, highest_rated, newest
   - `max_results` — per source, default 5

2. **Cross-source result merging**:
   - Common result schema: name, type (node_pack|model), source, relevance_score, installed, url
   - Node packs from registry only (CivitAI/HF don't have nodes)
   - Models from registry + CivitAI + HuggingFace
   - Deduplication: same model name from different sources → keep highest-ranked
   - Ranking: installed status boosted, relevance score primary

3. **Net tool reduction**: Remove search_custom_nodes, search_models, search_civitai (3). Add discover (1). 62 → 60 tools.

4. **Tests**: ~15-20 new tests for the unified tool. Update tool count assertions.

   210→def _load_custom_nodes() -> list[dict]:
   211→    """Load and cache custom-node-list.json."""
   212→    if _cache["custom_nodes"] is not None:

   214→
   215→    path = _MANAGER_DIR / "custom-node-list.json"
   216→    if not path.exists():
   217→        return []
   218→
   219→    try:
   220→        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   221→        _cache["custom_nodes"] = data.get("custom_nodes", [])
   222→        _freshness["custom_nodes_loaded_at"] = time.time()
   223→    except Exception:

   226→    return _cache["custom_nodes"]

   229→def _load_extension_map() -> dict:
   230→    """Load and cache extension-node-map.json."""

   233→
   234→    path = _MANAGER_DIR / "extension-node-map.json"
   235→    if not path.exists():

   237→
   238→    try:

   240→        _freshness["extension_map_loaded_at"] = time.time()

   247→def _build_node_to_pack() -> dict[str, dict]:
   248→    """Build reverse index: node_type -> {url, title, node_types}."""
   249→    if _cache["node_to_pack"] is not None:
   250→        return _cache["node_to_pack"]
   251→
   252→    ext_map = _load_extension_map()
   253→    index = {}
   254→    for url, entry in sorted(ext_map.items()):  # He2025: sorted iteration for deterministic collision resolution
   255→        if not isinstance(entry, list) or len(entry) < 2:
   256→            continue
   257→        node_types = entry[0] if isinstance(entry[0], list) else []
   258→        meta = entry[1] if isinstance(entry[1], dict) else {}
   259→        title = meta.get("title_aux", url.split("/")[-1] if "/" in url else url)
   260→
   261→        pack_info = {"url": url, "title": title, "node_count": len(node_types)}
   262→        for nt in node_types:
   263→            index[nt] = pack_info
   264→
   265→    _cache["node_to_pack"] = index
   266→    return index

   311→def _handle_search_custom_nodes(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   312→    query = tool_input["query"]
   313→    by = tool_input.get("by", "name")
   314→    max_results = tool_input.get("max_results", 10)
   315→
   316→    if by == "node_type":
   317→        return _search_by_node_type(query, max_results)
   318→    else:
   319→        return _search_by_name(query, max_results)

   322→def _search_by_node_type(query: str, max_results: int) -> str:
   323→    """Find which pack provides a specific node type."""
   324→    index = _build_node_to_pack()
   325→
   326→    if not index:
   327→        return to_json({
   328→            "error": (
   329→                "ComfyUI Manager not found. Install it from "
   330→                "https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager"
   331→            ),
   332→        })
   333→
   334→    # Exact match first
   335→    if query in index:
   336→        pack = index[query]
   337→        return to_json({
   338→            "match": "exact",
   339→            "node_type": query,
   340→            "pack": {
   341→                "title": pack["title"],
   342→                "url": pack["url"],
   343→                "node_count": pack["node_count"],
   344→                "installed": _is_pack_installed(pack["url"]),
   345→            },
   346→        })
   347→
   348→    # Fuzzy match — case-insensitive substring, sorted for determinism
   349→    query_lower = query.lower()
   350→    matches = []
   351→    seen_packs = set()
   352→    for nt, pack in sorted(index.items()):
   353→        if query_lower in nt.lower() and pack["url"] not in seen_packs:
   354→            seen_packs.add(pack["url"])
   355→            matches.append({
   356→                "node_type": nt,
   357→                "pack_title": pack["title"],
   358→                "pack_url": pack["url"],
   359→                "installed": _is_pack_installed(pack["url"]),
   360→            })
   361→            if len(matches) >= max_results:
   362→                break
   363→
   364→    if not matches:
   365→        return to_json({
   366→            "match": "none",
   367→            "node_type": query,
   368→            "message": f"No pack found providing '{query}'. Check the spelling.",
   369→            "total_known_types": len(index),
   370→        })
   371→
   372→    return to_json({
   373→        "match": "fuzzy",
   374→        "query": query,
   375→        "results": matches,
   376→        "total_matches": len(matches),
   377→    })

   380→def _search_by_name(query: str, max_results: int) -> str:
   381→    """Search custom node packs by title/description/author."""
   382→    packs = _load_custom_nodes()
   383→
   384→    if not packs:
   385→        return to_json({
   386→            "error": (
   387→                "ComfyUI Manager not found. Install it from "
   388→                "https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager"
   389→            ),
   390→        })
   391→
   392→    query_lower = query.lower()
   393→    query_words = query_lower.split()
   394→    scored = []
   395→
   396→    for pack in packs:
   397→        title = pack.get("title", "")
   398→        desc = pack.get("description", "")
   399→        author = pack.get("author", "")
   400→        searchable = f"{title} {desc} {author}".lower()
   401→
   402→        # Score: all words match > some words match
   403→        word_hits = sum(1 for w in query_words if w in searchable)
   404→        if word_hits == 0:
   405→            continue
   406→
   407→        # Boost exact title match
   408→        score = word_hits
   409→        if query_lower in title.lower():
   410→            score += 10
   411→
   412→        ref = pack.get("reference", "")
   413→        scored.append((score, {
   414→            "title": title,
   415→            "author": author,
   416→            "description": desc[:200] if desc else "",
   417→            "url": ref,
   418→            "install_type": pack.get("install_type", ""),
   419→            "installed": _is_pack_installed(ref) if ref else False,
   420→        }))
   421→
   422→    scored.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1].get("title", "")))
   423→    results = [r for _, r in scored[:max_results]]
   424→
   425→    return to_json({
   426→        "query": query,
   427→        "results": results,
   428→        "total_matches": len(scored),
   429→        "showing": len(results),
   430→    })

   445→def _search_model_registry(query: str, model_type: str | None, max_results: int) -> str:
   446→    """Search ComfyUI Manager's model-list.json."""
   447→    models = _load_model_list()
   448→
   449→    if not models:
   450→        return to_json({
   451→            "error": (
   452→                "ComfyUI Manager model list not found. Install ComfyUI Manager "
   453→                "or try source='huggingface' for online search."
   454→            ),
   455→        })
   456→
   457→    query_lower = query.lower()
   458→    query_words = query_lower.split()
   459→    scored = []
   460→
   461→    for model in models:
   462→        name = model.get("name", "")
   463→        mtype = model.get("type", "")
   464→        base = model.get("base", "")
   465→        desc = model.get("description", "")
   466→        searchable = f"{name} {mtype} {base} {desc}".lower()
   467→
   468→        # Apply type filter if given
   469→        if model_type and model_type.lower() not in mtype.lower():
   470→            continue
   471→
   472→        word_hits = sum(1 for w in query_words if w in searchable)
   473→        if word_hits == 0:
   474→            continue
   475→
   476→        score = word_hits
   477→        if query_lower in name.lower():
   478→            score += 10
   479→
   480→        filename = model.get("filename", "")
   481→        save_path = model.get("save_path", "")
   482→
   483→        scored.append((score, {
   484→            "name": name,
   485→            "type": mtype,
   486→            "base": base,
   487→            "description": desc[:200] if desc else "",
   488→            "filename": filename,
   489→            "url": model.get("url", ""),
   490→            "size": model.get("size", ""),
   491→            "save_path": save_path,
   492→            "installed": _is_model_installed(filename, save_path) if filename and save_path else False,
   493→        }))
   494→
   495→    scored.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1].get("name", "")))
   496→    results = [r for _, r in scored[:max_results]]
   497→
   498→    return to_json({
   499→        "source": "registry",
   500→        "query": query,
   501→        "type_filter": model_type,
   502→        "results": results,
   503→        "total_matches": len(scored),
   504→        "showing": len(results),
   505→    })

   508→def _search_huggingface(query: str, model_type: str | None, max_results: int) -> str:
   509→    """Search HuggingFace Hub API for models."""
   510→    params = {
   511→        "search": query,
   512→        "sort": "downloads",
   513→        "direction": "-1",
   514→        "limit": max_results,
   515→    }
   516→
   517→    # Map model types to HuggingFace tags
   518→    if model_type:
   519→        type_tags = {
   520→            "checkpoint": "diffusers",
   521→            "lora": "lora",
   522→            "vae": "vae",
   523→            "controlnet": "controlnet",
   524→            "embedding": "textual-inversion",
   525→        }
   526→        tag = type_tags.get(model_type.lower())
   527→        if tag:
   528→            params["filter"] = tag
   529→
   530→    if not HUGGINGFACE_LIMITER().acquire(timeout=5.0):
   531→        return to_json({"error": "Rate limited — too many HuggingFace requests. Try again shortly."})
   532→
   533→    try:
   534→        with httpx.Client() as client:
   535→            resp = client.get(
   536→                "https://huggingface.co/api/models",
   537→                params=params,
   538→                timeout=15.0,
   539→            )
   540→            resp.raise_for_status()
   541→            data = resp.json()
   542→    except httpx.ConnectError:
   543→        return to_json({"error": "Could not reach HuggingFace API. Check your internet connection."})
   544→    except httpx.HTTPStatusError as e:
   545→        return to_json({"error": f"HuggingFace API returned {e.response.status_code}."})
   546→    except Exception as e:
   547→        return to_json({"error": f"HuggingFace search failed: {e}"})
   548→
   549→    results = []
   550→    for item in data:
   551→        model_id = item.get("modelId", item.get("id", ""))
   552→        results.append({
   553→            "name": model_id,
   554→            "author": model_id.split("/")[0] if "/" in model_id else "",
   555→            "downloads": item.get("downloads", 0),
   556→            "likes": item.get("likes", 0),
   557→            "tags": item.get("tags", [])[:5],
   558→            "url": f"https://huggingface.co/{model_id}",
   559→            "last_modified": item.get("lastModified", ""),
   560→        })
   561→
   562→    return to_json({
   563→        "source": "huggingface",
   564→        "query": query,
   565→        "type_filter": model_type,
   566→        "results": results,
   567→        "showing": len(results),
   568→    })

   571→def _handle_find_missing_nodes(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   572→    path_str = tool_input.get("path")
   573→
   574→    # Get workflow
   575→    if path_str:
   576→        path = Path(path_str)
   577→        if not path.exists():
   578→            return to_json({"error": f"File not found: {path_str}"})
   579→        try:
   580→            data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   581→        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
   582→            return to_json({"error": f"Invalid JSON: {e}"})
   583→
   584→        # Extract API-format nodes
   585→        if "nodes" in data and isinstance(data["nodes"], list):
   586→            prompt_data = data.get("extra", {}).get("prompt")
   587→            if prompt_data and isinstance(prompt_data, dict):
   588→                workflow = {
   589→                    k: v for k, v in prompt_data.items()
   590→                    if isinstance(v, dict) and "class_type" in v
   591→                }
   592→            else:
   593→                # UI-only: extract class_types from nodes array
   594→                workflow = {}
   595→                for node in data["nodes"]:
   596→                    nid = str(node.get("id", ""))
   597→                    ntype = node.get("type", "")
   598→                    if ntype:
   599→                        workflow[nid] = {"class_type": ntype, "inputs": {}}
   600→        else:
   601→            workflow = {
   602→                k: v for k, v in data.items()
   603→                if isinstance(v, dict) and "class_type" in v
   604→            }
   605→    else:
   606→        from .workflow_patch import get_current_workflow
   607→        workflow = get_current_workflow()
   608→        if workflow is None:
   609→            return to_json({
   610→                "error": (
   611→                    "No workflow loaded. Either provide a 'path' or load one "
   612→                    "with apply_workflow_patch first."
   613→                ),
   614→            })
   615→
   616→    # Collect unique class_types
   617→    class_types = set()
   618→    for node in workflow.values():
   619→        ct = node.get("class_type")
   620→        if ct:
   621→            class_types.add(ct)
   622→
   623→    if not class_types:
   624→        return to_json({"error": "No nodes found in workflow."})
   625→
   626→    # Check which are available in live ComfyUI
   627→    available = set()
   628→    try:
   629→        with httpx.Client() as client:
   630→            resp = client.get(f"{COMFYUI_URL}/object_info", timeout=15.0)
   631→            resp.raise_for_status()
   632→            object_info = resp.json()
   633→            available = set(object_info.keys())
   634→    except httpx.ConnectError:
   635→        return to_json({
   636→            "error": "ComfyUI not reachable. Start ComfyUI to check node availability.",
   637→        })
   638→    except Exception as e:
   639→        return to_json({"error": f"Could not fetch node info: {e}"})
   640→
   641→    # Classify
   642→    installed = sorted(class_types & available)
   643→    missing = sorted(class_types - available)
   644→
   645→    # Look up missing nodes in extension-node-map
   646→    index = _build_node_to_pack()
   647→    missing_report = []
   648→    packs_needed = {}  # url -> {title, nodes}
   649→
   650→    for node_type in missing:
   651→        pack_info = index.get(node_type)
   652→        if pack_info:
   653→            url = pack_info["url"]
   654→            if url not in packs_needed:
   655→                packs_needed[url] = {
   656→                    "title": pack_info["title"],
   657→                    "url": url,
   658→                    "installed": _is_pack_installed(url),
   659→                    "missing_nodes": [],
   660→                }
   661→            packs_needed[url]["missing_nodes"].append(node_type)
   662→
   663→            missing_report.append({
   664→                "node_type": node_type,
   665→                "pack_title": pack_info["title"],
   666→                "pack_url": url,
   667→                "pack_installed": _is_pack_installed(url),
   668→            })
   669→        else:
   670→            missing_report.append({
   671→                "node_type": node_type,
   672→                "pack_title": None,
   673→                "pack_url": None,
   674→                "message": "Not found in ComfyUI Manager registry.",
   675→            })
   676→
   677→    # Summary
   678→    if not missing:
   679→        return to_json({
   680→            "status": "all_installed",
   681→            "total_node_types": len(class_types),
   682→            "message": "All node types in this workflow are available.",
   683→        })
   684→
   685→    return to_json({
   686→        "status": "missing_nodes",
   687→        "total_node_types": len(class_types),
   688→        "installed_count": len(installed),
   689→        "missing_count": len(missing),
   690→        "missing_nodes": missing_report,
   691→        "packs_to_install": list(packs_needed.values()),
   692→        "install_hint": (
   693→            "Install missing packs via ComfyUI Manager or git clone into "
   694→            f"{CUSTOM_NODES_DIR}"
   695→        ),
   696→    })

   699→def _handle_get_install_instructions(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   700→    """Get install instructions for a node pack or model."""
   701→    query = tool_input["query"]
   702→    source = tool_input.get("source", "registry")
   703→
   704→    if source == "civitai":
   705→        return to_json({
   706→            "source": "civitai",
   707→            "query": query,
   708→            "instructions": (
   709→                f"To install a CivitAI model, use the CivitAI tools to find the "
   710→                f"model first (search_civitai), then download the file to the "
   711→                f"appropriate directory under {MODELS_DIR}. "
   712→                f"CivitAI models are typically .safetensors files."
   713→            ),
   714→            "steps": [
   715→                f"1. Use search_civitai to find '{query}' and get the download URL",
   716→                "2. Note the model type (checkpoint, lora, controlnet, etc.)",
   717→                f"3. Download to {MODELS_DIR}/<type>/ directory",
   718→                "4. Restart ComfyUI or refresh the model list",
   719→            ],
   720→        })
   721→
   722→    if source == "huggingface":
   723→        return to_json({
   724→            "source": "huggingface",
   725→            "query": query,
   726→            "instructions": (
   727→                f"To install a HuggingFace model, download the .safetensors file "
   728→                f"to the appropriate directory under {MODELS_DIR}."
   729→            ),
   730→            "steps": [
   731→                f"1. Use search_models with source='huggingface' to find '{query}'",
   732→                "2. Note the model type and download the .safetensors file",
   733→                f"3. Place in {MODELS_DIR}/<type>/ directory",
   734→                "4. Restart ComfyUI or refresh the model list",
   735→            ],
   736→        })
   737→
   738→    # Registry source — look up node packs and models
   739→    # Try node pack first (by node_type)
   740→    index = _build_node_to_pack()
   741→    if query in index:
   742→        pack = index[query]
   743→        url = pack["url"]
   744→        installed = _is_pack_installed(url)
   745→        folder = url.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1]
   746→        if folder.endswith(".git"):
   747→            folder = folder[:-4]
   748→        return to_json({
   749→            "source": "registry",
   750→            "type": "node_pack",
   751→            "query": query,
   752→            "pack_title": pack["title"],
   753→            "installed": installed,
   754→            "install_commands": [
   755→                f"cd {CUSTOM_NODES_DIR}",
   756→                f"git clone {url}",
   757→                f"pip install -r {CUSTOM_NODES_DIR / folder / 'requirements.txt'} "
   758→                f"(if exists)",
   759→                "Restart ComfyUI",
   760→            ] if not installed else [],
   761→            "message": "Already installed." if installed else f"Clone {url} into Custom_Nodes.",
   762→        })
   763→
   764→    # Try node pack by name search
   765→    packs = _load_custom_nodes()
   766→    query_lower = query.lower()
   767→    for pack in packs:
   768→        title = pack.get("title", "")
   769→        ref = pack.get("reference", "")
   770→        if query_lower in title.lower() or query_lower in ref.lower():
   771→            installed = _is_pack_installed(ref) if ref else False
   772→            folder = ref.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1] if ref else ""
   773→            if folder.endswith(".git"):
   774→                folder = folder[:-4]
   775→            return to_json({
   776→                "source": "registry",
   777→                "type": "node_pack",
   778→                "query": query,
   779→                "pack_title": title,
   780→                "installed": installed,
   781→                "install_commands": [
   782→                    f"cd {CUSTOM_NODES_DIR}",
   783→                    f"git clone {ref}",
   784→                    f"pip install -r {CUSTOM_NODES_DIR / folder / 'requirements.txt'} "
   785→                    f"(if exists)",
   786→                    "Restart ComfyUI",
   787→                ] if not installed and ref else [],
   788→                "message": "Already installed." if installed else f"Clone {ref} into Custom_Nodes.",
   789→            })
   790→
   791→    # Try model registry
   792→    models = _load_model_list()
   793→    for model in models:
   794→        name = model.get("name", "")
   795→        if query_lower in name.lower():
   796→            filename = model.get("filename", "")
   797→            save_path = model.get("save_path", "")
   798→            url = model.get("url", "")
   799→            installed = _is_model_installed(filename, save_path) if filename and save_path else False
   800→            return to_json({
   801→                "source": "registry",
   802→                "type": "model",
   803→                "query": query,
   804→                "model_name": name,
   805→                "installed": installed,
   806→                "install_commands": [
   807→                    f"Download: {url}",
   808→                    f"Save to: {MODELS_DIR / save_path / filename}",
   809→                    "Restart ComfyUI or refresh model list",
   810→                ] if not installed and url else [],
   811→                "message": "Already installed." if installed else f"Download {filename} to {save_path}/.",
   812→            })
   813→
   814→    return to_json({
   815→        "source": "registry",
   816→        "query": query,
   817→        "error": f"Could not find '{query}' in the registry. Try search_custom_nodes or search_models first.",
   818→    })
   819→
   820→
   821→def _clear_cache():
   822→    """Clear all in-memory caches, forcing reload from disk on next access."""
   823→    _cache["custom_nodes"] = None
   824→    _cache["extension_map"] = None
   825→    _cache["node_to_pack"] = None
   826→    _cache["model_list"] = None
   827→    _freshness["custom_nodes_loaded_at"] = None
   828→    _freshness["extension_map_loaded_at"] = None
   829→    _freshness["model_list_loaded_at"] = None
   830→
   831→
   832→def _file_age_info(path: Path) -> dict:
   833→    """Get age info for a file. Returns dict with exists, modified_at, age_s, age_human."""
   834→    if not path.exists():
   835→        return {"exists": False, "path": str(path)}
   836→
   837→    mtime = path.stat().st_mtime
   838→    age_s = time.time() - mtime
   839→    age_days = age_s / 86400
   840→
   841→    if age_days < 1:
   842→        age_human = f"{age_s / 3600:.1f} hours"
   843→    else:
   844→        age_human = f"{age_days:.1f} days"
   845→
   846→    if age_s > _WARN_THRESHOLD:
   847→        status = "very_stale"
   848→    elif age_s > _STALE_THRESHOLD:
   849→        status = "stale"
   850→    else:
   851→        status = "fresh"
   852→
   853→    return {
   854→        "exists": True,
   855→        "path": str(path),
   856→        "age_seconds": round(age_s),
   857→        "age_human": age_human,
   858→        "status": status,
   859→    }
   860→
   861→
   862→def _model_dir_stats() -> dict:
   863→    """Count model files by type in the models directory."""
   864→    if not MODELS_DIR.exists():
   865→        return {"exists": False, "path": str(MODELS_DIR)}
   866→
   867→    types = {}
   868→    for subdir in sorted(MODELS_DIR.iterdir()):
   869→        if subdir.is_dir():
   870→            count = sum(1 for f in subdir.iterdir() if f.is_file() and f.suffix in (
   871→                ".safetensors", ".ckpt", ".pt", ".pth", ".bin",
   872→            ))
   873→            if count > 0:
   874→                types[subdir.name] = count
   875→
   876→    return {
   877→        "exists": True,
   878→        "path": str(MODELS_DIR),
   879→        "types": types,
   880→        "total_files": sum(types.values()),
   881→    }
   882→
   883→
   884→def _handle_check_freshness(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   885→    """Check freshness of registry data and model files."""
   886→    if tool_input.get("refresh"):
   887→        _clear_cache()
   888→
   889→    # Check registry files
   890→    registry_files = {
   891→        "custom_node_list": _MANAGER_DIR / "custom-node-list.json",
   892→        "extension_node_map": _MANAGER_DIR / "extension-node-map.json",
   893→        "model_list": _MANAGER_DIR / "model-list.json",
   894→    }
   895→
   896→    registries = {}
   897→    any_stale = False
   898→    any_missing = False
   899→    for key, path in sorted(registry_files.items()):
   900→        info = _file_age_info(path)
   901→        registries[key] = info
   902→        if not info.get("exists"):
   903→            any_missing = True
   904→        elif info.get("status") in ("stale", "very_stale"):
   905→            any_stale = True
   906→
   907→    # Cache status
   908→    cache_status = {
   909→        "custom_nodes_cached": _cache["custom_nodes"] is not None,
   910→        "extension_map_cached": _cache["extension_map"] is not None,
   911→        "node_to_pack_cached": _cache["node_to_pack"] is not None,
   912→        "model_list_cached": _cache["model_list"] is not None,
   913→    }
   914→
   915→    # Model directory stats
   916→    models = _model_dir_stats()
   917→
   918→    # Build recommendations
   919→    recommendations = []
   920→    if any_missing:
   921→        recommendations.append(
   922→            "Install ComfyUI Manager to get registry data: "
   923→            "https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager"
   924→        )
   925→    if any_stale:
   926→        recommendations.append(
   927→            "Registry files are stale. Open ComfyUI Manager in the browser "
   928→            "and click 'Update ComfyUI Manager' to refresh."
   929→        )
   930→    if tool_input.get("refresh"):
   931→        recommendations.append("In-memory cache cleared. Next search will reload from disk.")
   932→
   933→    return to_json({
   934→        "registries": registries,
   935→        "cache": cache_status,
   936→        "models": models,
   937→        "manager_installed": _MANAGER_DIR.exists(),
   938→        "recommendations": recommendations,
   939→        "refreshed": bool(tool_input.get("refresh")),
   940→    })
   941→
   942→
   943→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   944→# Dispatch
   945→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   946→
   947→def handle(name: str, tool_input: dict) -> str:
   948→    """Execute a comfy_discover tool call."""
   949→    try:
   950→        if name == "search_custom_nodes":
   951→            return _handle_search_custom_nodes(tool_input)
   952→        elif name == "search_models":
   953→            return _handle_search_models(tool_input)
   954→        elif name == "find_missing_nodes":
   955→            return _handle_find_missing_nodes(tool_input)
   956→        elif name == "get_install_instructions":
   957→            return _handle_get_install_instructions(tool_input)
   958→        elif name == "check_registry_freshness":
   959→            return _handle_check_freshness(tool_input)
   960→        else:
   961→            return to_json({"error": f"Unknown tool: {name}"})
   962→    except Exception as e:
   963→        return to_json({"error": str(e)})
